src: 越通社河内——越通社特派记者报道，在访问文莱达鲁萨兰国期间，2月11日上午，越南政府总理范明政与夫人走访了文莱达鲁萨兰大学（UBD，简称“文莱大学”）。
raw: Vietnam News Agency, Hanoi – A special correspondent from the Vietnam News Agency reports that during their visit to the Kingdom of Brunei Darussalam, on the morning of February 11th, Vietnamese Prime Minister Nguyen Minh Triet and his wife paid a visit to the University of Brunei Darussalam (UBD, also referred to as “Brunei University”).

src: 文莱大学是文莱最大的高等高等教育和科学研究中心，在本地区大学排行榜上位居第三。
raw: Brunei University is the largest institution of higher education and scientific research in Brunei, and it ranks third among universities in the region.

src: 文莱大学是越南与文莱在教育培训合作中的象征之一。
raw: The University of Brunei is one of the symbols of cooperation between Vietnam and Brunei in the field of education and training.

src: 文莱大学于2013年7月正式与越南FPT大学建立合作关系，主要合作领域是英语培训。
raw: Brunei University officially established a partnership with Vietnam’s FPT University in July 2013, with the main area of cooperation being English language training.

src: 除了英语、法语、德育、日语和韩语等外语外，文莱大学还将越南语纳入教学课程。
raw: In addition to foreign languages such as English, French, Moral Education, Japanese, and Korean, the University of Brunei has also included Vietnamese in its curriculum.

src: 走访文莱大学时，越南政府总理范明政和夫人同越南语班的学生进行了交流。
raw: During the visit to Brunei University, Vietnamese Prime Minister Phan Minh Chinh and his wife exchanged views with the students of the Vietnamese language class.

src: 范明政总理为越来越多的外国人喜欢学习越南语而感到高兴，进而为把越南文化特色和风土人情形象推广到世界各地作出积极贡献。
raw: Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh is pleased that an increasing number of foreigners are taking an interest in learning Vietnamese, which in turn contributes positively to the promotion of Vietnamese cultural characteristics and local customs around the world.

src: 政府总理范明政表示相信并希望文莱大学的越南语教师队伍日益强大；越南语班的学员越来越对越南语感兴趣，努力学习，能够早日使用流利的越南语，并成为越文两国友好合作关系的使者。
raw: Prime Minister Phan Minh Chinh expressed his belief and hope that the team of Vietnamese language teachers at the University of Brunei will continue to grow stronger. He also noted that the students taking Vietnamese language courses are becoming increasingly interested in the language, studying hard, and will soon be able to speak fluent Vietnamese. He hopes they will become messengers of friendly cooperation between Vietnam and Brunei.

src: 趁此机会，范明政总理还通过视频方式与正在岘港市FPT-UBD全球中心学习英语的越南学生进行交流，了解他们特别是在疫情期间的学习情况。
raw: Taking this opportunity, Prime Minister Phan Minh Chinh also communicated via video with Vietnamese students who are learning English at the FPT-UBD Global Center in Da Nang City, to learn about their learning progress, especially during the pandemic.

src: 政府总理范明政认为，越南FPT大学与文莱大学之间的合作关系特别是FPT-UBD全球中心是越南与文莱教育合作关系中的生动象征。
raw: Vietnamese Prime Minister Phan Minh Chinh believes that the cooperation between FPT University in Vietnam and the University of Brunei, especially the FPT-UBD Global Center, is a vivid symbol of the educational partnership between Vietnam and Brunei.

src: 同时希望该中心的学生在学习中取得更大的进步，为越文两国友好合作关系作出积极的贡献。
raw: At the same time, it is hoped that the students at this center will make greater progress in their studies and contribute positively to the friendly and cooperative relations between Vietnam and China.

src: 范明政总理在与文莱教育部部长和文莱大学领导展开讨论时高度评价两国在教育合作中所取得的成效，其中包括FPT大学与文莱大学之间的合作，以及文莱大学将越南语纳入教学课程这一举措。
raw: During discussions with the Minister of Education of Brunei and the leadership of Brunei University, Prime Minister Tan Ming Chong highly praised the achievements made in educational cooperation between the two countries. These achievements include the collaboration between FPT University and Brunei University, as well as the decision by Brunei University to incorporate the Vietnamese language into its curriculum.

src: 范明政总理希望文莱大学将继续关注确保越南语教学质量并进一步扩大越南语班的规模。
raw: Prime Minister Phan Minh Chinh hopes that the University of Brunei will continue to focus on ensuring the quality of Vietnamese language teaching and further expand the scale of Vietnamese language courses.

src: 越南政府总理范明政还高度评价两国在于2014年4月签署的教育合作谅解备忘录基础上的合作所取得的积极成效；建议文莱继续提供更多的奖学金并有效开展各项短期互换培训项目，如：环球探索项目（Global Discovery Programme）、探索之年（Discovery Year）等。
raw: Vietnamese Prime Minister Phan Minh Chinh also highly praised the positive results of the cooperation between the two countries, which is based on the Memorandum of Understanding on Educational Cooperation signed in April 2014. He suggested that Brunei continue to provide more scholarships and effectively implement various short-term exchange training programs, such as the Global Discovery Programme and the Discovery Year.

src: 范明政总理高度赞赏文莱大学在越南设立其在东南亚第一个分校；相信该大学在地区和世界上的发展规模日益强大；进一步扩大与越南高等院校的合作关系。
raw: Prime Minister Phan Minh Chinh highly commended the University of Brunei for establishing its first branch in Southeast Asia in Vietnam, believing that the university’s influence and development on both the regional and global scale will continue to grow. He also expressed his support for further expanding cooperation with Vietnamese higher education institutions.

src: 借此机会，范明政总理和夫人在文莱大学校园内种下纪念树，并在纪念簿上留言。
raw: Taking this opportunity, Prime Minister Fan Mingzheng and his wife planted a commemorative tree on the campus of the University of Brunei and left a message in the commemorative book.

src: 范明政总理祝愿文莱大学不断向前发展，为文莱的教育事业贡献越来越大的力量，并且与越南各所教育培训机构开展更深更广的合作。
raw: Prime Minister Fan Mingzheng wishes that the University of Brunei will continue to make progress, contribute increasingly to Brunei’s education sector, and engage in deeper and broader cooperation with various educational institutions in Vietnam.

src: “全球复苏的重要引擎”-中新网
raw: “An important engine for global recovery” – China News Service

src: “应对新冠疫情冲击，中国经济展现出了强大韧性。
raw: “In response to the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, the Chinese economy has demonstrated remarkable resilience.”

src: 近期市场预期表明，国际社会普遍看好中国未来发展。
raw: Recent market expectations indicate that the international community generally has a positive outlook for China's future development.

src: ”西班牙知名中国问题专家、中国政策观察网名誉顾问胡里奥·里奥斯日前接受本报记者采访时表示，当前中国疫情防控进入新阶段，经济社会发展活力将进一步得到释放。
raw: “Julio Rios, a well-known expert on China issues in Spain and an honorary advisor to the China Policy Observation Network, recently stated in an interview with our newspaper that China’s epidemic prevention and control efforts have entered a new phase, and the vitality of economic and social development will be further unleashed.”

src: 里奥斯表示，面对各种超预期因素冲击，中国以非凡的经济治理经验和措施沉着应对，充分体现出其经济韧性和管理水平。
raw: Rios stated that in the face of various factors that exceeded expectations, China responded calmly with its remarkable economic governance experience and measures, fully demonstrating its economic resilience and management capabilities.

src: 中国坚定不移扩大对外开放的同时，经济发展的内生动力不断增强，国有企业和民营企业协同发展。
raw: While China unswervingly expands its opening up to the outside world, the internal driving forces for economic development continue to strengthen, with state-owned enterprises and private enterprises developing in a coordinated manner.

src: 每年中国全国两会召开，代表委员共商国家发展大计、共议民生热点问题，广泛凝聚共识、凝聚人心、凝聚智慧，为中国发展增添力量。
raw: Every year, when the Two Sessions are held nationwide in China, representatives and committee members discuss the country's development strategies and address key issues related to people's livelihoods. They work together to build consensus, unite people's hearts, and pool wisdom, thereby adding strength to China's progress.

src: “自改革开放以来，中国实现了长期高速发展，目前进入了高质量发展阶段。
raw: “Since the reform and opening up, China has achieved long-term, rapid development and has now entered a stage of high-quality development.”

src: 国际社会期待中国智慧和中国方案，期待中国发展为世界带来新机遇。
raw: The international community looks forward to China’s wisdom and solutions, and anticipates that China’s development will bring new opportunities to the world.

src: ”里奥斯说，当前中国正全力推动科技创新，为经济社会发展注入新动力，“资金投入、人才培养、政策激励，这让中国在新的五年规划中继续充满活力”。
raw: Rios said that China is currently making every effort to promote technological innovation in order to inject new momentum into economic and social development. “The investment in funds, the cultivation of talent, and the policy incentives have ensured that China remains full of vitality in its new five-year plan.”

src: 在里奥斯看来，经济体制改革对任何国家来说都是一项艰巨的任务。
raw: In the view of Rios, economic system reform is a daunting task for any country.

src: 在中国共产党领导下，中国既发挥市场经济的长处，又发挥社会主义制度的优越性，采取积极主动措施稳定经济。
raw: Under the leadership of the Communist Party of China, China has made use of both the advantages of a market economy and the strengths of the socialist system, taking proactive measures to stabilize its economy.

src: 围绕扩大内需的战略基点，加大金融支持实体经济的力度，支持民营、中小企业和制造业发展，坚持创新发展，促进就业、提高中国民众的收入和生活水平，满足人民多层次多样化消费需求……中国完整、准确、全面贯彻新发展理念，着力推动高质量发展，构建新发展格局，将为世界带来更多增长机遇。
raw: Focusing on the strategic foundation of expanding domestic demand, China is increasing financial support for the real economy, promoting the development of private enterprises, small and medium-sized businesses, and the manufacturing sector. It adheres to innovative development, aims to boost employment, and improve the income and living standards of its citizens, while meeting the diverse and multi-level consumer needs of the population. By fully, accurately, and comprehensively implementing the new development concepts, China is committed to driving high-quality growth and establishing a new development pattern, which will bring more opportunities for growth to the world.

src: 今年是共建“一带一路”倡议提出10周年。
raw: This year marks the 10th anniversary of the proposal of the “Belt and Road” initiative.

src: “疫情后经济企稳复苏是国际社会的共同目标。
raw: "The stabilization and recovery of the economy after the pandemic is a common goal for the international community."

src: 中国经济发展潜力不断释放，将给世界各国带来更多利好，成为全球复苏的重要引擎。
raw: The economic development potential of China continues to be unleashed, bringing more benefits to countries around the world and becoming an important engine for global recovery.

src: ”里奥斯表示，期待共建“一带一路”合作继续发挥其改善各国基础设施水平、加强各领域互联互通的重要作用，继续释放更大动能。
raw: Rios stated that he looks forward to the cooperation under the Belt and Road Initiative continuing to play its important role in improving the infrastructure levels of various countries and enhancing connectivity across different sectors, thereby generating even greater momentum.

src: 健身行业应摆脱信任危机-中新网
raw: The fitness industry should overcome the crisis of trust – China News Service

src: 又一大型健身房“暴雷”？
raw: Another major gym “exploded” (i.e., faced significant problems or failures)?

src: 近日，知名健身机构中健健身会员维权问题引起社会关注。
raw: Recently, the issue of members of the well-known fitness institution Zhongjian Fitness seeking to protect their rights has attracted public attention.

src: 春节后不少会员发现自己所在门店没有正常营业，随后，关于该机构倒闭跑路的传闻引起会员恐慌，导致公安、人社部门介入。
raw: After the Spring Festival, many members discovered that the stores where they worked were not operating normally. Subsequently, rumors about the institution going bankrupt and its owners running away caused panic among the members, which led to the intervention of the public security and human resources departments.

src: 最后，该机构相关负责人出面回应，承诺会努力保障好员工和会员的合法权益，风波才得以平息。
raw: Finally, a representative from the organization came forward to respond, promising to make efforts to protect the legitimate rights and interests of employees and members, which helped to calm the situation down.

src: 个别健身机构的部分门店出现经营问题，暂时关闭，消费者本可心平气和等待问题解决，为何不少会员的第一反应是“大事不妙”？
raw: Some stores of certain fitness establishments are experiencing operational issues and have temporarily closed. Consumers could reasonably wait patiently for the problems to be resolved. Why, then, is the first reaction of many members that “something serious has gone wrong”?

src: 健身俱乐部会员维权风波背后，是行业信任危机的深层次问题。
raw: Behind the controversy over members of fitness clubs seeking to protect their rights, there are deeper issues related to a crisis of trust in the industry.

src: 国内传统健身房普遍采取预付费模式，“赚用户不来的钱”是其发展的底层逻辑。
raw: Traditional fitness studios in China generally adopt a prepaid model, with the underlying logic being to “earn money that users would not otherwise spend.”

src: 通过预售会员卡获取现金流，不断开新店，看似能够循环往复，实则寅吃卯粮，无法形成稳定的盈利模式。
raw: Generating cash flow through pre-sale membership cards and continuously opening new stores may seem like a sustainable cycle, but in reality, it’s like using money from future revenues to pay for current expenses, preventing the establishment of a stable profit model.

src: 健身房跑路等行业负面信息频频传出，对消费者信心造成强烈冲击。
raw: Negative news from industries such as those involving people who flee from fitness gyms is frequently circulating, causing a strong impact on consumers' confidence.

src: 从市场前景看，健身房当然算得上是一门有“钱途”的好生意。
raw: From a market perspective, fitness studios are certainly a profitable business with great potential for success.

src: 健身赛道虽然起起伏伏，但始终受到资本关注。
raw: Although the fitness track industry has its ups and downs, it has always received attention from investors (capital).

src: 多项数据显示，文体消费等领域热度不断攀升，市场持续回暖。
raw: Multiple data points indicate that sectors such as cultural and entertainment consumption are experiencing increasing popularity, with the market continuing to recover.

src: 具体到健身市场，随着居民生活水平稳步提高，健康生活理念深入人心，健身行业发展大有可为。
raw: Specifically in the fitness market, as the standard of living of residents continues to improve and the concept of a healthy lifestyle becomes more widely accepted, the fitness industry has great potential for growth.

src: 形势越是趋好，行业越需重视发展质量。
raw: The better the situation becomes, the more the industry needs to focus on the quality of its development.

src: 然而，个别机构对消费复苏后的健身市场盲目乐观，刚从危机中走出来，又吹响开疆拓土的号角，把融资资金一股脑投入新店建设上。
raw: However, some individual institutions are overly optimistic about the fitness market after the recovery in consumer spending. Having just emerged from the crisis, they once again raise the banner of expansion and invest all their financing funds in the construction of new stores.

src: 不可否认，这几年受疫情影响，不少机构退出，行业重新洗牌，有实力的企业此时选择性地加大收购力度、重新布局，未尝不是新机遇。
raw: It is undeniable that in recent years, due to the impact of the pandemic, many institutions have withdrawn from the market, leading to a reshuffle of the industry. For capable companies, this could be an opportunity to selectively increase their acquisitions and restructure their strategies.

src: 但是，健身市场发展要想进入良性循环，迈上行稳致远的康庄大道，行业就必须改变传统模式，改变经营策略。
raw: However, for the fitness market to enter a virtuous cycle and embark on a path of steady and sustainable growth, the industry must change its traditional models and business strategies.

src: 只有稳扎稳打，重新建立起消费者的信任度、安全感，才能真正赢得市场、赢得未来。
raw: Only by taking steady steps and rebuilding consumers' trust and sense of security can we truly win the market and secure our future.

src: 相比大建新店抢占市场，健身行业当前更需要的是沉下心来优化服务，用高质量发展来稳住用户。
raw: Rather than aggressively opening new stores to capture the market, the fitness industry currently needs to focus on improving its services and maintaining customer loyalty through high-quality development.

src: 首先，要靠服务留住用户。
raw: First of all, it’s necessary to retain users through good service.

src: 健身房属于服务行业，其本质是坚持“用户导向”，要紧紧围绕用户需求，把经营重心放在服务提质升级上。
raw: The fitness industry belongs to the service sector, and its essence is to adhere to a “user-oriented” approach. It is essential to closely focus on the needs of users and prioritize the improvement and enhancement of the quality of services provided.

src: 其次，要靠数字化转型提升用户体验。
raw: Secondly, it is necessary to enhance the user experience through digital transformation.

src: 比如当下流行的互联网健身房模式，实现用户按次付费和场地自选。
raw: For example, the currently popular online fitness gym model allows users to pay per session and choose their own workout location.

src: 同时，身体数据、运动数据得以有效利用，还可以满足社交需求，实现从线上到线下完整的服务闭环。
raw: At the same time, physical and athletic data can be effectively utilized, and social needs can also be met, thus creating a complete service ecosystem that spans both online and offline environments.

src: 没有私教推销，没有巨额年卡，用户对健身机构“跑路”的担忧降低了，信任感也就提升了。
raw: No personal trainers pitching their services, no expensive annual membership fees – these factors have reduced users’ concerns about fitness studios “going out of business” (i.e., closing down), thereby increasing their trust in such establishments.

src: 另外，还要积极探索多元业态。
raw: Additionally, it is also necessary to actively explore a variety of business models.

src: 如今，体育消费已经从单一服务走向场景消费，健身俱乐部有望成为消费新入口，围绕健身所需的运动补给和健身器械等周边产品或将成为新的盈利点，为消费者提供更丰富选择。
raw: Today, sports consumption has shifted from being based on individual services to being context-based (i.e., depending on the specific situation in which the service is used). Fitness clubs are expected to become a new entry point for such consumption. Peripheral products related to exercise, such as supplements and fitness equipment, may become new sources of revenue, offering consumers a wider range of choices.

src: 买贵退差价！
raw: Buy at a high price and get the difference refunded!

src: 南京楼市再现“差价赔付”-中新网
raw: The Nanjing real estate market sees the recurrence of “price difference compensation” – China News Service

src: 扬子晚报讯(记者 马祚波)扬子晚报/紫牛新闻记者10日在采访中发现，十余年未见的“保价协议”又重回了南京楼市，位于江北新区的一家楼盘宣称“差价赔付”，在交房前其他房源的优惠大于之前的折扣，开发商愿意为买房人换房并退还差价。
raw: Yangtze Evening News (Reporter Ma Zuobo): During an interview on the 10th, reporters from Yangtze Evening News/Ziniu News discovered that the “price guarantee agreement,” which had not been seen for over a decade, had reappeared in the Nanjing real estate market. A property development project in the Jiangbei New Area claimed to offer “price difference compensation.” Before the property was handed over, the discounts available on other properties were greater than those previously offered. The developer was willing to exchange the house for a new one for the buyer and refund the price difference.

src: “保价协议”条件可不少
raw: The terms of a “guaranteed price agreement” can be quite numerous.

src: 这家位于江北新区的楼盘名为保利扬子萃云台，看房人孙先生告诉记者，他在上周末逛楼盘时发现了一则“声明”。
raw: The property located in the Jiangbei New Area is called Poly Yangtze Cuiyuntai. Mr. Sun, a potential buyer, told the reporter that he discovered a “statement” while visiting the property last weekend.

src: 他发给记者的图片上显示，该楼盘的开发商承诺，凡是在2月1日-2月28日期间购买房源的，自双方签订买卖合同之日起至对应房源交付，若该项目其他房源的优惠折扣大于之前购房所享折扣的(限与该商品房属于同一户型、同一楼栋、同一单元、同一物业类型的其他未售商品房)，开发商可以为购房者换房并退还差价。
raw: The image sent to the journalists shows that the developer of the property promised that for any purchase made between February 1st and February 28th, if the discount offered on other properties in the same project is greater than the discount already received (limited to other unsold properties in the same apartment type, building, unit, and property category as the purchased property), the developer would allow the buyer to exchange the property and refund the difference in price.

src: 孙先生表示，置业顾问表示这其实就是一份“保价协议”，目的是让买家放心出手，不用担心开发企业降价促销，“现在就怕买完了它就降价了，去售楼处闹吧没时间，不闹的话也确实窝心”。
raw: Mr. Sun stated that the real estate consultant explained that this is essentially a “price guarantee agreement” designed to reassure buyers, ensuring they don’t have to worry about the developer reducing the price as a promotional tactic. “The main concern now is that the price might drop after the purchase is made. If you go to the sales office to protest, you might not have the time; and even if you do, it’s still very frustrating.”

src: 还有不少买房人则认为，“保价协议”虽然是在给购房者吃“定心丸”，不过条件却不低。
raw: Many homebuyers also believe that although the “price guarantee agreement” is intended to provide them with some peace of mind, the terms and conditions are quite demanding.

src: 打算在江北买一套刚需房的郑女士说，保价的房源首先是要同一户型，还得在同一楼栋、同一个单元，买家可以比价的房源寥寥，因此“门槛”还是蛮高的。
raw: Ms. Zheng, who plans to buy a necessary housing unit in the north of the river, said that the properties offered at a guaranteed price must first have the same layout, as well as be located in the same building and on the same floor. There are very few properties available for buyers to compare prices with, so the “barriers” to purchasing such units are quite high.

src: 也有购房者认为，由于信息不对称，销售时不排除给出额外的让利，买家“维权”的难度不小。
raw: Some homebuyers also believe that, due to information asymmetry, it is not ruled out that additional concessions may be made during the sale process. As a result, it can be quite difficult for buyers to “protect their rights.”

src: 能否留住买房人有待观察
raw: Whether it will be possible to retain the homebuyers remains to be seen.

src: 记者在南京网上房地产上查询得知，该楼盘于去年11月首领两幢楼共计252套房源的销许，户型面积有105平方米、114平方米、129平方米等，全装修销许均价为39843元/㎡。
raw: Journalists learned from the Nanjing online real estate platform that the property obtained the construction permit for two buildings in November last year, offering a total of 252 units. The available apartment sizes range from 105 square meters to 129 square meters, and the average selling price for the fully furnished units was 39,843 yuan per square meter.

src: 不过两个多月过去，网上房地产显示目前该楼盘的未售总套数为157套，占比为62.3%，其中8号楼共计128套，未售套数达113套，7号楼的124套中也有44套未售，项目的总成交套数只有33套，占比仅为13%。
raw: However, more than two months have passed, and according to online real estate listings, the total number of unsold units in this property is 157, which accounts for 62.3%. Of these, Building 8 has 128 units, with 113 still unsold; Building 7 has 124 units, of which 44 are also unsold. The total number of units that have been sold in the entire project is only 33, which represents a mere 13% of the total units.

src: 市场人士介绍，“保价协议”在2008年也曾在南京出现过。
raw: Market insiders mentioned that “price guarantee agreements” also appeared in Nanjing in 2008.

src: 当年8月份，河西黄山路上的楼盘横塘西苑为了吸引买房人眼球，推出了《保价计划》，具体内容为“公司郑重承诺，若一年内项目优惠幅度扩大，由此产生的差额，公司将按差额退还给老业主”。
raw: In August of that year, in order to attract potential homebuyers, the property project Hengtang Xiyuan on Huangshan Road in Hexi launched a “Price Guarantee Plan.” The details of the plan were as follows: “The company solemnly promises that if the discount offered on the project increases within one year, the company will refund the difference to the existing homeowners.”

src: 此后2011年4月，南京也有9家楼盘拿出部分房源承诺“差价赔付”。
raw: Subsequently, in April 2011, nine properties in Nanjing also offered a portion of their units, promising to compensate for any price differences.

src: “楼市在回暖，此时更需要一针‘强心剂’。
raw: “The real estate market is beginning to recover, and at this time, a ‘stimulant’ is even more needed.”

src: ”南京地产行业一位资深操盘手沈先生表示，“保价协议”也是房企的营销方式之一。
raw: Mr. Shen, a senior operator in the real estate industry in Nanjing, stated that “price guarantee agreements” are also one of the marketing strategies used by real estate companies.

src: 他认为如今开发企业比买房人更需要信心，推出“保价协议”其实也是在给其打气。
raw: He believes that nowadays, development companies need more confidence than homebuyers do, and introducing “price guarantee agreements” is actually a way to boost their morale.

src: 至于能否留住买房人，他表示这取决于调控政策、贷款门槛等多重因素的影响，就目前来看仍有待观察。
raw: As for whether it is possible to retain the homebuyers, he stated that this depends on a variety of factors such as regulatory policies and loan requirements, and at present, it remains to be seen.

src: 中国救援队在土耳其持续开展救援行动 已营救4名被困人员-中新网
raw: The Chinese rescue team continues its rescue operations in Turkey and has already rescued 4 people in distress – China News Service

src: 中新网2月11日电 据应急管理部网站11日消息，2月10日，正在土耳其搜救的中国救援队派出3个行动分队、45名救援队员，营救出1名被困人员。
raw: China News Service, February 11: According to a statement on the website of the Ministry of Emergency Management on the 11th, on February 10, the Chinese rescue team, which was conducting search and rescue operations in Turkey, dispatched three action teams and 45 rescuers, successfully saving one person who was trapped.

src: 同时派出2个搜索评估组，对沃达巴什大街15栋建筑进行评估排查。
raw: Two search and assessment teams were dispatched simultaneously to evaluate and inspect the 15 buildings on Voda Babas Street.

src: 截至目前，共营救4名被困人员，搜寻出5名遇难者，对25栋倒塌严重的建筑进行生命迹象和风险评估。
raw: To date, four people trapped have been rescued, five victims have been identified, and life signs and risk assessments have been conducted on 25 buildings that have collapsed severely.

src: 救援队将根据灾区实际和救援现场情况，科学调整救援力量，持续深入开展救援工作。
raw: The rescue team will scientifically adjust the rescue efforts based on the actual situation of the affected area and the conditions at the rescue site, and continue to carry out the rescue work in a thorough manner.

src: 救援队通过使馆、当地政府、联合国救援组织等多种渠道获取救援求助信息，通过线上询情、现场搜索等多种方式进行逐一核实。
raw: The rescue teams obtain information about people in need of assistance through various channels such as embassies, local governments, and United Nations relief organizations. They verify each case individually by conducting online inquiries and on-site searches.

src: 向中国香港救援队介绍目前救援环境和建筑坍塌等情况，联合开展搜索行动。
raw: Inform the rescue team from Hong Kong, China about the current rescue situation and the circumstances of the building collapse, and jointly carry out the search operations.

src: 目前与意大利救援队联合负责区域协调(SSC5)，同时派遣3名队员参加5号区域救援协调中心工作，与意大利、英国、塞尔维亚、斯洛伐克、阿曼等多支队伍进行沟通，了解了联合国救援组织和各国救援队救援工作情况。
raw: Currently, I am responsible for regional coordination (SSC5) in conjunction with the Italian rescue team. Additionally, three of our team members have been dispatched to work at the Rescue Coordination Center for Region 5. We have communicated with various teams from Italy, the United Kingdom, Serbia, Slovakia, Oman, and other countries, and have gained an understanding of the rescue efforts conducted by the United Nations relief organizations as well as the local rescue teams.

src: 救援队持续强化安全管理和队伍保障，按照“统一指挥、安全第一”原则，加强救援现场安全管控，强化救援工作纪律要求，明确安全注意事项。
raw: The rescue team continues to strengthen safety management and support for its members. In accordance with the principles of “unified command and safety first,” they have enhanced the safety control at the rescue site, tightened the disciplinary requirements for rescue operations, and clarified the necessary safety precautions.

src: 持续运行轮值备勤和岗哨工作制度，强化营区安全管理。
raw: Continue to implement the system of rotating shifts for standby and patrol duties to enhance the security management of the camp area.

src: 救援队医疗人员每天为队员提供体检服务，加强重点人员医疗保障，目前救援队全员身体健康，开展营区消杀。
raw: The medical personnel of the rescue team provide daily health check-ups for the team members, focusing on enhancing the medical care for key individuals. At present, all members of the rescue team are in good health, and disinfection measures are being carried out throughout the camp area.

src: 自营地建立后，后勤保障队员共搭建了指挥通信、装备存放、医疗洗消、生活住宿及犬舍等4大类26顶野战帐篷，保障现场救援装备30余套件。
raw: After the camp was established, the logistics support team set up a total of 26 field tents in four main categories: command and communication, equipment storage, medical decontamination, and living quarters, as well as a dog shelter. This ensured the availability of more than 30 sets of rescue equipment on site.

src: 金正恩父女互动亲密 老婆遭冷落一旁
raw: Kim Jong-un and his daughter have a close and intimate relationship; his wife is left aside and neglected.

src: （综合11日电）朝鲜8日晚间举行建军节第75周年阅兵仪式，领导人金正恩的女儿金主爱不仅出席，还与父亲一同站上主席台。
raw: (Comprehensive report from the 11th): On the evening of the 8th, North Korea held a parade to celebrate the 75th anniversary of its founding. Kim Jong-un’s daughter, Kim Ju-ae, not only attended the event but also stood on the podium alongside her father.

src: 朝鲜官媒9日公布影片，金主爱依偎在父亲身边，数次温情对视、讲悄悄话，她用双手轻捧老爸的脸颊，甚至摸著父亲胸口，父女互动画面播送至举国上下。
raw: North Korean state media released a video on the 9th showing Kim Ju-ae cuddling up to her father, exchanging several affectionate looks and whispering to him. She gently held her father’s cheeks with both hands and even touched his chest. The moments of interaction between mother and daughter were broadcast throughout the country.

src: 然而，第一夫人李雪主只能退到一旁。
raw: However, First Lady Ri Sol Ju could only step aside.

src: 综合韩国“朝鲜新闻”等报导，金正恩、李雪主夫妇7日带著女儿金主爱出席晚宴的官方合照中，金主爱不仅罕见坐在父母正中间C位，在隔日晚间建军节第75周年阅兵仪式上，她还与金正恩一起登上主席台。
raw: According to reports from Korean sources such as “Chosun News,” on the 7th, Kim Jong-un and his wife Ri Sol-ju attended an official dinner. In the official photo of the couple with their daughter Kim Ju-ae, Kim Ju-ae not only sat in the center, between her parents—a rare occurrence—but the following evening, during the 75th anniversary parade of the Army Day, she also joined Kim Jong-un on the podium.

src: 朝鲜官媒“朝鲜中央电视台”事后释出阅兵式影片，曝光了更多父女情深的画面。
raw: The North Korean state media, “Korean Central Television,” released footage of the military parade later on, revealing more moments that demonstrated the deep bond between fathers and daughters.

src: 金正恩在主席台上数次与女儿对望，两人脸上的笑容从未退去，还互相在耳边讲悄悄话，金主爱一度以双手捧起老爸的两颊，金正恩也以灿笑回应。
raw: Kim Jong Un looked at his daughter several times from the podium; both of them maintained smiles on their faces and whispered to each other. At one point, the younger Kim held her father’s cheeks with both hands, to which Kim Jong Un responded with a bright smile.

src: 其他官媒画面也显示，金主爱与金正恩坐在室内沙发椅上时，用手不断摸著父亲的脸；她与父亲挽著手走路时，一边用手摸在金正恩的胸口。
raw: Other images from state media also show that when Kim Jong-un and his sister-in-law were sitting on the indoor sofa, she kept touching her father’s face with her hand; while walking arm in arm with her father, she placed her hand on Kim Jong-un’s chest as well.

src: 而第一夫人李雪主全程只能走在后头或是坐在一旁，总是距离丈夫和女儿有几步之差。
raw: And First Lady Lee Sol Ju could only walk at the back or sit on the side throughout the entire event, always staying a few steps away from her husband and daughter.

src: 韩国媒体指出，金主爱自去年11月18日试射火星17飞弹首次在公开露脸以来，3个月以来曝光机率越来越高，至今已是第5度出现于正式场合。
raw: South Korean media reports that since Kim Jong-un first appeared in public after the test launch of the Mars 17 missile on November 18 last year, his exposure has increased significantly over the past three months. This is already the fifth time he has appeared in a formal setting.

src: 朝鲜官媒提及金主爱时使用了最亲爱的子弟、尊贵的子弟等极高尊称，也播出金主爱在看台上俯瞰阅兵行进时反覆高喊誓死拥护白头血统的片段。
raw: North Korean state media used extremely respectful terms such as “the most beloved son” and “the honorable son” when referring to Kim Jong-un. They also aired footage of Kim Jong-un standing on the podium, looking down at the military parade, repeatedly shouting slogans expressing his pledge to defend the “White-haired Bloodline” (the royal lineage of the Kim family).

src: 这些迹象让外界怀疑金主爱是否已经被内定为金氏政权的继承人，《华盛顿邮报》分析认为“这是金正恩把中学年纪的女儿推上接班人地位的讯号”，不过也有观点认为，这样的判断仍为时过早，在金正恩膝下有儿子的情况中，仍保有各种可能性。
raw: These signs have led to speculation abroad about whether Kim Jong-un’s favorite daughter has been predetermined as the successor to the Kim regime. The Washington Post analyzes this as “a signal that Kim Jong-un is pushing his daughter, who is in middle school age, towards the position of successor.” However, there are also opinions that it is still too early to make such a judgment, as various possibilities remain given that Kim Jong-un has sons as well.

src: 新华社评论员：推进中国式现代化是一个系统工程——四论深刻领会习近平总书记在学习贯彻党的二十大精神研讨班开班式重要讲话-中新网
raw: Xinhua News Agency commentator: Promoting Chinese-style modernization is a systematic endeavor – Four discussions on thoroughly understanding the important speech delivered by General Secretary Xi Jinping at the opening ceremony of the seminar on studying and implementing the spirit of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China – China News Service

src: 新华社北京2月11日电 题：推进中国式现代化是一个系统工程——四论深刻领会习近平总书记在学习贯彻党的二十大精神研讨班开班式重要讲话
raw: Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, February 11th – Title: Promoting Chinese-style modernization is a systematic endeavor: Four discussions on thoroughly understanding the important speech delivered by General Secretary Xi Jinping at the opening ceremony of the seminar on studying and implementing the spirit of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China

src: 新华社评论员
raw: Xinhua News Agency commentator

src: “推进中国式现代化是一个系统工程，需要统筹兼顾、系统谋划、整体推进，正确处理好顶层设计与实践探索、战略与策略、守正与创新、效率与公平、活力与秩序、自立自强与对外开放等一系列重大关系。
raw: “Advancing Chinese-style modernization is a systematic endeavor that requires comprehensive planning, integrated consideration, and coordinated progress. It is essential to properly manage a range of critical relationships, including those between top-level design and practical exploration, strategy and tactics, maintaining tradition while fostering innovation, efficiency and fairness, vitality and order, as well as self-reliance and openness to the outside world.”

src: ”在新进中央委员会的委员、候补委员和省部级主要领导干部学习贯彻习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想和党的二十大精神研讨班开班式上，习近平总书记科学把握现代化建设规律，深入系统阐明实践中需要处理好的一系列重大关系，为我们大力推进中国式现代化提供了科学方法论。
raw: At the opening ceremony of the seminar for newly appointed members and alternate members of the Central Committee, as well as for key leaders at the provincial and ministerial levels, to study and implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era and the spirit of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, General Secretary Xi Jinping scientifically understood the laws of modernization. He thoroughly and systematically explained a series of important relationships that need to be properly managed in practice, providing us with a scientific methodology for vigorously advancing Chinese-style modernization.

src: 推进中国式现代化涉及经济、政治、文化、社会、生态文明等各个领域，关系治党治国治军、内政外交国防等方方面面，既要做好系统谋划，又要勇于改革创新，不断实现整体推进。
raw: Advancing China’s path of modernization involves various fields such as the economy, politics, culture, society, and ecological civilization, and it relates to all aspects of governance, including the management of the Party, the state, the military, as well as domestic affairs, foreign policy, and national defense. It requires both comprehensive strategic planning and the courage for reform and innovation, in order to continuously make progress as a whole.

src: 进行顶层设计，需要深刻洞察世界发展大势，准确把握人民群众的共同愿望，深入探索经济社会发展规律，使制定的规划和政策体系体现时代性、把握规律性、富于创造性，做到远近结合、上下贯通、内容协调。
raw: To carry out top-level design, it is necessary to have a profound understanding of the general trends in world development, accurately grasp the common aspirations of the people, and thoroughly explore the laws of economic and social development. The resulting planning and policy frameworks should reflect the characteristics of the times, adhere to these laws, and be innovative. They must take into account both short-term and long-term considerations, ensure coherence from top to bottom, and have well-coordinated content.

src: 推进中国式现代化是一个探索性事业，还有许多未知领域，需要在实践中去大胆探索，通过改革创新来推动事业发展，决不能刻舟求剑、守株待兔。
raw: Advancing Chinese-style modernization is an exploratory endeavor, with many unknown areas that require bold exploration in practice. We must promote development through innovation and reform, rather than adopting outdated methods or waiting for opportunities to come to us in a passive manner.

src: 战略问题是一个政党、一个国家的根本性问题。
raw: Strategic issues are fundamental to a political party or a country.

src: 推进中国式现代化，要增强战略的前瞻性，以科学的战略预见未来、引领未来；要增强战略的全局性，着眼于解决事关党和国家事业兴衰成败、牵一发而动全身的重大问题；要增强战略的稳定性，战略一经形成，就要长期坚持、一抓到底、善作善成。
raw: To advance China’s path of modernization, it is essential to enhance the strategic foresight needed to predict and guide the future using scientific methods. Strategic thinking must also take a holistic approach, focusing on resolving major issues that are critical to the success or failure of the Party and the country’s endeavors—issues that can have a profound impact on the entire situation. Furthermore, strategic stability must be ensured; once a strategy is established, it must be adhered to over the long term, pursued consistently, and executed with excellence.

src: 要科学把握战略和策略的辩证统一关系，把战略的原则性和策略的灵活性有机结合起来，灵活机动、随机应变、临机决断，在因地制宜、因势而动、顺势而为中把握战略主动。
raw: It is necessary to scientifically understand the dialectical unity between strategy and tactics, organically combining the principle-based nature of strategy with the flexibility of tactics. One should be adaptable, responsive to changing circumstances, and capable of making quick decisions. By adapting measures to local conditions, responding to prevailing trends, and acting in accordance with the situation, one can gain the initiative in strategic planning.

src: 中华民族是守正创新的民族。
raw: The Chinese nation is one that upholds tradition while also innovating.

src: 处理好守正与创新的关系，既要守好中国式现代化的本和源、根和魂，毫不动摇坚持中国式现代化的中国特色、本质要求、重大原则，确保中国式现代化的正确方向，又要把创新摆在国家发展全局的突出位置，顺应时代发展要求，着眼于解决重大理论和实践问题，积极识变应变求变，大力推进改革创新，不断塑造发展新动能新优势，充分激发全社会创造活力。
raw: It is essential to properly balance tradition and innovation. On one hand, we must safeguard the essence, origins, roots, and soul of Chinese-style modernization, unwaveringly upholding its unique characteristics, fundamental requirements, and key principles to ensure its correct direction. On the other hand, innovation must be given a prominent place in the overall national development strategy. We must align with the demands of the times, focus on solving major theoretical and practical issues, actively recognize and respond to changes, and vigorously promote reform and innovation. This will help to foster new drivers and advantages for development, fully unleashing the creative vitality of the entire society.

src: 效率是公平的重要基础，公平是效率的有力保证。
raw: Efficiency is an important foundation for fairness, and fairness is a strong guarantee of efficiency.

src: 我们推进中国式现代化，既要创造比资本主义更高的效率，又要更有效地维护社会公平，更好实现效率与公平相兼顾、相促进、相统一。
raw: As we pursue Chinese-style modernization, we must not only achieve higher efficiency than that of capitalism but also more effectively maintain social fairness. We need to find a better way to balance, promote, and integrate efficiency and fairness.

src: 处理好效率与公平的关系，不断实现发展为了人民、发展依靠人民、发展成果由人民共享，让现代化建设成果更多更公平惠及全体人民。
raw: It is essential to strike a proper balance between efficiency and fairness, continuously ensuring that development is for the people, relies on the people, and its benefits are shared by the people. This will enable the fruits of modernization to benefit all citizens more extensively and equitably.

src: 推进中国式现代化，需要处理好活力与秩序的关系，让社会既充满活力又安定有序。
raw: To advance China's path of modernization, it is necessary to properly manage the relationship between vitality and order, ensuring that society is both dynamic and stable.

src: 要统筹好发展和安全两件大事，贯彻总体国家安全观，健全国家安全体系，增强维护国家安全能力，坚定维护国家政权安全、制度安全、意识形态安全和重点领域安全。
raw: It is essential to coordinate the development and security priorities effectively, implement the overall national security concept, improve the national security system, and enhance the capacity to safeguard national security. We must resolutely protect the security of the state power, the political system, the ideology, as well as the security of key sectors.

src: 既在发展中更多考虑安全因素，通过发展提升国家安全实力，运用发展成果来夯实国家安全的基础，又善于营造有利于经济社会发展的安全环境，不断激发发展活力，实现高质量发展和高水平安全的良性互动。
raw: On one hand, more consideration is given to security factors during development; national security capabilities are enhanced through development, and the benefits of development are utilized to strengthen the foundations of national security. On the other hand, there is a keen ability to create a secure environment conducive to economic and social development, continuously stimulating vitality for growth and achieving a positive interaction between high-quality development and a high level of security.

src: 推进中国式现代化，既要坚持走自己的路，又要拓展世界眼光，坚持对外开放，不断拓展中国式现代化的广度和深度。
raw: To advance Chinese-style modernization, it is necessary to adhere to our own path while also broadening our global perspective and maintaining an open attitude towards the outside world. This will help to continuously expand the scope and depth of Chinese-style modernization.

src: 要坚持独立自主、自立自强，坚持把国家和民族发展放在自己力量的基点上，坚持把我国发展进步的命运牢牢掌握在自己手中。

raw: We must continuously expand high-level opening up to the outside world, deeply participate in global industrial division of labor and cooperation, make good use of both domestic and international resources, and broaden the space for China's path to modernization. src: 循道而行，方能致远。

src: 让我们在以习近平同志为核心的党中央坚强领导下、在习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想科学指引下，把握规律、笃行不怠，充分发挥积极性、主动性、创造性，正确处理好一系列重大关系，在全面建设社会主义现代化国家新征程上奋发有为，不断开辟中国式现代化新境界。
raw: Under the strong leadership of the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core, and guided by the scientific theories of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, let us grasp the underlying principles and persevere with determination. Thus, we will continuously open up new horizons for China’s path to modernization.

src: 同抗中共 美日菲达成防卫共识
raw: United in the fight against the CCP: The US, Japan, and the Philippines reach a consensus on defense measures

src: 亚洲 – 2月9日，菲律宾总统小马科斯（Bongbong Marcos）造访日本，与首相岸田文雄会谈。
raw: Asia – On February 9, Philippine President Bongbong Marcos visited Japan and met with Prime Minister Fumio Kishida.

src: 双方就反对中共侵犯南海与东海达成共识，菲日领导人在会后发布共同声明表示，将通过和美国签署三边防卫协议，进行实质防务交流，反对中共霸权政策。
raw: The two sides reached a consensus on opposing the Chinese Communist Party’s encroachments in the South China Sea and the East China Sea. After the meeting, Philippine and Japanese leaders issued a joint statement stating that they would engage in substantial defense exchanges through the signing of a trilateral defense agreement with the United States, in order to oppose the Chinese Communist Party’s hegemonic policies.

src: 根据日本媒体的说法，岸田文雄希望藉这次会晤帮助日菲两国建立针对台海危机的政策。
raw: According to Japanese media, Fumio Kishida hopes to use this meeting to help establish a joint policy between Japan and the Philippines in response to the Taiwan Strait crisis.

src: 小马科斯今年1月初曾访华，并且获得价值200亿美元的协议。
raw: Little Marcos visited China in early January this year and secured agreements worth $20 billion.

src: 但在这之后，中菲关系不仅没好转，反倒下滑。
raw: But after that, Sino-Philippine relations not only did not improve, but rather declined.

src: 本月初，菲律宾与美国签署协议，同意对美军开放更多基地，保障南海安全。
raw: Earlier this month, the Philippines and the United States signed an agreement agreeing to open more bases to U.S. military forces in order to ensure security in the South China Sea.

src: 新增加的一个基地距离台湾300公里，也是最接近中国的一个地点。
raw: The newly added base is located 300 kilometers from Taiwan and is also the closest point to China.

src: 如果台湾出现危机，美军可能会在菲律宾的基地发动行动。
raw: If a crisis occurs in Taiwan, the U.S. military might launch operations from its bases in the Philippines.

src: 日本媒体认为，现在日韩台澳乃至菲律宾都与美国形成轴心，构建西太平洋的“对抗中共弧线”，以推动地区合作。
raw: Japanese media believe that Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Australia, and even the Philippines are now forming an alliance with the United States to create a “counter-China arc” in the Western Pacific, in order to promote regional cooperation.

src: 中国鼓励拉高生育率 到高校催捐精 质量高标准
raw: China encourages higher birth rates and urges universities to collect sperm donations, setting high standards for the quality of the sperm.

src: 中国云南省人类精子库9日发出宣传，征求大专以上学历者或在校生捐精，成功捐赠8至12次可获人民币4500元补贴。
raw: On the 9th, the Human Sperm Bank in Yunnan Province, China, issued a promotional notice seeking donations of sperm from individuals with a college degree or above, as well as current students. Those who successfully donate sperm 8 to 12 times can receive a subsidy of 4,500 yuan.

src: 据台媒今天报道称，该讯息当日冲上微博热搜，并引发浙江、陕西、湖北、山东与北京等许多省市跟进倡议。
raw: According to reports by Taiwanese media today, the message quickly became a hot topic on Weibo that day and triggered follow-up initiatives in many provinces and cities, including Zhejiang, Shaanxi, Hubei, Shandong, and Beijing.

src: 据自由时报署名报道称，中国鼓励大学生捐精。
raw: According to a report attributed to The Liberty Times, China encourages college students to donate sperm.

src: 各地高校捐精其中北京捐精门槛最高，除学历外，也要求身高170公分以上、五官端正、无明显脱发、近视度数不能高于600度。
raw: Colleges and universities across the country are accepting donations of sperm, with Beijing having the highest requirements for donors. In addition to educational qualifications, donors must be at least 170 centimeters tall, have well-defined facial features, no significant hair loss, and their myopia degree cannot exceed 600 degrees.

src: 据该报道称，云南省人类精子库指出，捐精者可获得价值1000人民币的全套男科体检，“尤其精液与染色体检测，大部分人从未做过，对了解自己的生育状态意义重大”。
raw: According to the report, the Yunnan Province Human Sperm Bank stated that sperm donors can receive a comprehensive male health check-up worth 1,000 RMB, “especially including semen and chromosome tests, which most people have never undergone and are very important for understanding their fertility status.”

src: 捐精者条件包括，身高165公分以上、大专及以上学历或在读，无色盲色弱、B肝等遗传疾病与传染病者。
raw: The requirements for sperm donors include a height of at least 165 cm, a college degree or higher, or currently being in school; as well as the absence of color blindness, color weakness, hereditary diseases such as hepatitis B, and infectious diseases.

src: 报道引述中国天目新闻消息指，陕西省人类精子库印有“有偿捐精，无限光荣”的宣传海报，呼吁年轻人响应捐精，并鼓励网友转发相关讯息，“让爱心传递”。
raw: The report cites news from China’s Tianmu News, stating that a human sperm bank in Shaanxi Province has posted promotional posters that read “Donating sperm for a fee is a great honor,” urging young people to donate sperm and encouraging netizens to share the information “so that love can be passed on.”

src: 陕西省价码高于云南，合格者每次可领取人民币300元现金，完成一定次数的捐精者可获得人民币5000元补贴。
raw: In Shaanxi Province, the fees are higher than those in Yunnan. Eligible individuals can receive a cash reward of 300 RMB per donation. Those who complete a certain number of donations will be eligible for a subsidy of 5,000 RMB.

src: 而目前已知价码最高的是北京，最高补贴5150人民币。
raw: And the highest known price code currently is for Beijing, with a maximum subsidy of 5150 RMB.

src: “基金E账户”来了：证监会授权开发 投资者名下所有基金实现归集和查询 - 经济观察网 － 专业财经新闻网站
raw: “The E-account for Funds” is here: The Securities Regulatory Commission has authorized its development, enabling the aggregation and retrieval of all funds under an investor’s name – Economic Observation Network, a professional financial news website

src: 经济观察网 记者 陈姗 基金购买渠道繁杂导致账户信息归集不易？
raw: Economic Observation Network Reporter Chen Shan: Are the complicated fund purchase channels making it difficult to gather account information?

src: 总是遗忘“小金库”？
raw: Always forgetting about that “little money nest”?

src: 基民的这些问题即将得到解决。
raw: These issues concerning the basic citizens are about to be resolved.

src: 2月10日，证监会公告称，“基金E账户”APP在各手机应用商店上架并开展公开试运行。
raw: On February 10, the China Securities Regulatory Commission announced that the “Fund E Account” app had been released in various mobile app stores and was undergoing a public trial period.

src: 据介绍，“基金E账户”为个人投资者提供公募基金账户及份额信息的“一站式”查询服务，旨在解决广大中小投资者遗忘账户、查询繁琐等行业服务痛点。
raw: According to the information provided, “Fund E Account” offers individual investors a “one-stop” service for accessing information regarding their public offering fund accounts and shares. The aim of this service is to address common issues in the industry, such as investors forgetting about their accounts or the cumbersome process of conducting account inquiries.

src: 据Wind数据显示，截至2022年底，国内共有公募基金管理人156家，管理基金规模约26万亿元；公募基金份额登记机构167家，公募基金销售机构411家。
raw: According to Wind data, as of the end of 2022, there were 156 domestic public fund managers in China, managing a total fund size of approximately 26 trillion yuan; there were 167 institutions responsible for registering public fund shares, and 411 institutions engaged in the sale of public funds.

src: 各份额登记机构账户体系相互独立，缺乏行业统一的查询渠道。
raw: The account systems of various share registration institutions are independent of each other, and there is a lack of a unified industry-wide channel for making inquiries.

src: 有行业人士表示，2021年末我国基金投资者超过7.2亿人，也就是说，全国有一半人都投资了基金产品。
raw: Industry insiders have stated that by the end of 2021, the number of fund investors in China exceeded 720 million people, which means that half of the country's population had invested in fund products.

src: 此前，投资者需要通过不同销售机构查询购买情况，而通过“基金E账户”可以查询所有销售渠道购买的情况，持有基金情况一目了然。
raw: Previously, investors had to check their purchase details through various sales institutions. With the “Fund E Account,” it is now possible to view all purchase information from all sales channels, making it clear at a glance which funds they hold.

src: “基金E账户”APP是什么？
raw: What is the “Fund E Account” APP?

src: 据相关文件介绍，“基金E账户”APP 是中国结算经中国证监会批准开发建设的公募基金行业门户手机应用，可为投资者提供全市场公募基金产品场外份额持有情况的一站式查询。
raw: According to the relevant documents, the “Fund E Account” APP is a mobile application developed and built by China Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation (CSDC) with the approval of the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC). It serves as a portal for the public fund industry, providing investors with a one-stop way to check the holdings of public fund products outside the official market (i.e., off-exchange shares).

src: 投资者可以通过“基金E账户”方便、快捷地掌握自己通过全市场各销售渠道购买的各基金管理人旗下公募基金产品场外份额的持有情况，全面提升查询效率。
raw: Investors can conveniently and quickly track their holdings of over-the-counter (OTC) shares of public funds issued by various fund managers, which they have purchased through all sales channels in the market, using the “Fund E Account”. This significantly enhances the efficiency of information retrieval.

src: 具体来说，投资者可以通过“基金E账户”查询到的信息包括：在全市场各公募基金管理人处开立的基金账户信息、在公募基金销售机构处开立的交易账户信息以及持有的包括公开募集证券投资基金以及证券公司设立管理的投资者人数不受200人限制的集合资产管理计划等产品的场外份额持有情况。
raw: Specifically, the information that investors can access through the “Fund E Account” includes: details of fund accounts opened with various public fund managers across the market; information on trading accounts opened with public fund sales institutions; and details of the off-exchange shares held in products such as publicly offered securities investment funds, as well as collective asset management plans established and managed by securities companies, which are not subject to the limit of 200 investors.

src: 上海证券基金评价研究中心业务负责人刘亦千向经济观察网记者表示，投资者可以通过“基金E账户”App一站式获知其所有的场外公募基金持有情况，帮助其找回“被遗忘的资产”，更重要的是为客户实现了综合基金投资情况的全账户信息归集，帮助客户更及时、准确、完整的掌握自身投资情况，从而更好地优化自身的基金组合配置，更好地规划自身的财务安排。
raw: Liu Yiqian, the person in charge of business at the Shanghai Securities Fund Evaluation and Research Center, told a reporter from Economic Observation Network that investors can use the “Fund E Account” app to obtain a one-stop view of all their holdings in over-the-counter public funds. This helps them recover “forgotten assets” and, more importantly, it enables the collection of comprehensive information on their entire fund investment portfolio. As a result, investors can gain a more timely, accurate, and complete understanding of their investment situation, which in turn allows them to better optimize their fund allocation and plan their financial arrangements.

src: 如何注册使用？
raw: How to register and use it?

src: 记者注意到，目前，“基金E账户”APP已在华为、苹果、小米、OPPO、vivo等手机应用商店上架，但APP尚处于公开试运行阶段，注册需要填写邀请码，投资者可以联系所持有基金的基金管理人获取。
raw: Journalists have noted that the “Fund E Account” app is currently available in the app stores of smartphones such as Huawei, Apple, Xiaomi, OPPO, and vivo. However, the app is still in the public trial phase, and registration requires entering an invitation code, which investors can obtain by contacting the fund manager of the funds they hold.

src: 上海一家中大型公募基金客服人员向经济观察网记者提供了一个6位数的邀请码，并告诉记者，“APP试运行阶段，中国结算提供给每个基金管理人一定数量的邀请码，投资者电话过来获取，我们都会提供。
raw: A customer service representative from a medium to large public fund in Shanghai provided a six-digit invitation code to a reporter from Economic Observation Network, stating, “During the trial operation phase of the app, China Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation provides a certain number of invitation codes to each fund manager. Investors who call to obtain these codes will be assisted by us.”

src: 等试运行结束后，开放用户注册时就不用邀请码了。
raw: Once the trial operation is completed, user registration will be available without the need for an invitation code.
Chinese: “

src: 记者根据证监会官网公示的“基金E账户”下载及使用说明相关文件进行了账户注册并完成查询，整个过程耗时仅几分钟，主要分为四步：用户注册、实名认证、基金账户绑定、公募基金查询。
raw: The journalist registered the account and completed the inquiry by downloading the relevant documents regarding the registration and usage instructions for the “Fund E Account” as published on the official website of the Securities Regulatory Commission. The entire process took only a few minutes and mainly consisted of four steps: user registration, real-name verification, fund account binding, and public offering fund inquiry.

src: 通过实名认证这一步之后，点击“资产”基金绑定按钮，记者通过各个基金销售平台购买的所有基金产品都呈现在绑定选项列表中（可绑定账户），完成绑定后就可以直观看到所投基金总资产并可以开始使用查询功能了。
raw: After completing the real-name authentication process, click the “Assets” button to bind the funds. All the fund products purchased by the reporter through various fund sales platforms will be displayed in the list of available binding options (available for binding to accounts). Once the binding is completed, you can directly view the total assets of the invested funds and start using the query functions.

src: 值得注意的是，“基金E账户”仅为投资者提供查询服务，并不能进行申赎买卖。
raw: It is worth noting that the “Fund E Account” only provides inquiry services for investors and does not allow for the purchase, sale, or redemption of funds.

src: “基金 E 账户”所显示的数据日期一般为用户进行查询的日期（T日)往前推三个交易日。
raw: The data date displayed in the “Fund E Account” is generally three trading days prior to the date (T-day) on which the user performs the query.

src: 比如，在2 月10日打开“基金E账户”，资产页所显示的总资产、基金份额、基金净值对应日期为该日期往前推三个交易日，即2月7日。
raw: For example, when you open the “Fund E Account” on February 10th, the total assets, the number of fund shares, and the net asset value displayed on the asset page correspond to the date three trading days prior to that day, which is February 7th.

src: 多项数据衰退 台湾经济开年表现不佳-中新网
raw: Multiple economic indicators have declined, indicating a poor start to the year for Taiwan’s economy – China News Service

src: 新华社台北2月11日电(记者赵博、黄扬)出口贸易额“连五黑”，制造业采购经理人指数(PMI)连续7个月紧缩，消费者物价指数(CPI)又见“3字头”……近期，台湾当局陆续发布2023年1月经济数据。
raw: Xinhua News Agency, Taipei, February 11 (Reporters Zhao Bo, Huang Yang) The volume of export trade has declined for five consecutive months; the Manufacturing Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) has been contracting for seven straight months; and the Consumer Price Index (CPI) has once again reached the “300s” range… Recently, the Taiwanese authorities have released the economic data for January 2023.

src: 专家分析认为，台湾经济开年表现欠佳，增长压力不小。
raw: Experts analyze that Taiwan's economy has performed poorly at the beginning of the year, and there is considerable pressure on growth.

src: 据台当局财政事务主管部门公布，台湾地区今年1月出口315.1亿美元，年减21.2%，连续第5个月负增长。
raw: According to the financial authorities in Taiwan, the region's exports in January this year amounted to 31.51 billion US dollars, a year-on-year decrease of 21.2%, marking the fifth consecutive month of negative growth.

src: 11项主要出口货类的出口额与去年同期相比，均出现衰退。
raw: The export volumes of all 11 major export categories have declined compared to the same period last year.

src: 塑橡胶及其制品、光学器材跌幅最深，分别年减37.6%、35.7%。
raw: Plastics, rubber and their products, as well as optical equipment, experienced the largest declines, with annual reductions of 37.6% and 35.7% respectively.

src: 电子零组件出口年减20.1%，创11年来最大减幅。
raw: The annual export of electronic components decreased by 20.1%, marking the largest decline in 11 years.

src: 其中，集成电路年减18.3%，创14年来最大跌势。
raw: Among them, the annual decline in integrated circuits was 18.3%, representing the largest decrease in 14 years.

src: 该部门统计处长蔡美娜表示，这显示消费性电子产业需求疲弱效应扩散，电子产业进入修正期。
raw: Cai Meina, the head of the statistics department at that ministry, stated that this indicates the spread of the weak demand effects within the consumer electronics industry, and that the electronics sector has entered a period of adjustment.

src: 统计显示，1月台湾地区进出口双降，出超金额仅23.4亿美元，创近3年来最低水平。
raw: Statistics show that in January, both imports and exports in Taiwan region declined. The trade surplus amounted to only $2.34 billion, the lowest level in nearly three years.

src: 台当局财政事务主管部门认为，全球终端需求减少，产业调整库存抑制厂商购料意愿，出口颓势短期难见改善，台湾今年首季出口衰退恐高于预期。
raw: The financial authorities in Taiwan believe that the decline in global final demand, along with industrial adjustments and inventory reductions, are discouraging manufacturers from purchasing materials. As a result, the worsening situation in exports is unlikely to improve in the short term. Taiwan's export performance in the first quarter of this year is expected to decline more severely than anticipated.

src: 据台湾中华经济研究院发布，今年1月台湾制造业采购经理人指数(PMI)经季节调整后为40.4%，较去年12月续跌3.3个百分点，连续7个月紧缩。
raw: According to the Taiwan China Economic Research Institute, the seasonally adjusted Manufacturing Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) for Taiwan in January this year was 40.4%, a further decline of 3.3 percentage points from December last year, marking the seventh consecutive month of contraction.

src: 经济监测指标体系中，PMI以50%为荣枯线，指数大于50%，代表景气扩张，反之为紧缩。
raw: In the economic monitoring indicator system, the PMI uses 50% as the dividing line between expansion and contraction. An index value above 50% indicates economic expansion, while a value below 50% indicates economic contraction.

src: 1月台湾PMI五项组成指标中，新增订单、生产与人力雇佣紧缩，供应商交货时间下降，存货紧缩。
raw: Among the five components of the Taiwan PMI in January, there was a contraction in new orders, production, and employment levels; supplier delivery times decreased, and inventory levels also tightened.

src: 六大产业全数回报PMI紧缩，各产业依紧缩速度排序为电力暨机械设备产业(35.1%)、电子暨光学产业(35.2%)、化学暨生技医疗产业(39.2%)、基础原物料产业(42.4%)、交通工具产业(42.6%)与食品暨纺织产业(45.7%)。
raw: All six industries reported a PMI (Purchasing Managers’ Index) contraction. The industries were ranked in order of the speed of contraction as follows: Electricity and Machinery Equipment (35.1%), Electronics and Optics (35.2%), Chemicals and Biotechnology/Medical (39.2%), Basic Raw Materials (42.4%), Transportation (42.6%), and Food and Textiles (45.7%).

src: 物价方面，台当局“主计总处”公布，今年1月台湾CPI年增率为3.04%，自去年7月以来再度冲破3%。
raw: Regarding prices, the Taiwan authorities’ “General Accounting Office” announced that the annual inflation rate in Taiwan in January this year was 3.04%, once again exceeding 3% for the first time since July last year.

src: 其中，蔬菜价格飞涨28.25%，创17个月新高。
raw: Among them, the price of vegetables soared by 28.25%, reaching a new high for the past 17 months.

src: 台“主计总处”专门委员曹志弘坦言，菜价涨幅确实超乎预期，排除春节因素，今年1月和2月平均CPI应接近去年12月的2.71%，通胀压力还是存在，且仍在高点。
raw: Cao Zhihong, a special commissioner from Taiwan’s “General Accounting Office,” frankly stated that the increase in vegetable prices has indeed exceeded expectations. Excluding the impact of the Spring Festival, the average CPI for January and February this year should be close to 2.71% in December last year. Inflationary pressures still exist and remain at a high level.

src: 展望今年台湾经济，综合《联合报》、“Yahoo财经”等岛内媒体报道，专家表示悲观。
raw: Looking ahead to this year’s Taiwanese economy, experts are pessimistic, based on reports from local media sources such as the United Daily and Yahoo Finance.

src: 台“中央大学”经济系教授吴大任分析，出口衰退可能造成出口制造业厂商现金流出现问题，债务违约风险上升。
raw: Wu Daren, a professor in the Department of Economics at National Chung Hsing University in Taiwan, analyzed that the decline in exports could lead to cash flow problems for export manufacturing companies, increasing the risk of debt defaults.

src: 同时，订单减少导致厂商削减人力成本，影响劳动市场和家庭经济，反过来冲击消费能力。
raw: At the same time, the decrease in orders leads manufacturers to cut labor costs, which affects the labor market and household economies, in turn impacting consumer purchasing power.

src: 台湾经济研究院研究员邱达生认为，今年欧美通胀状况未解，需求持续萎缩，预估台湾出口衰退会延续到上半年。
raw: Qiu Dasheng, a researcher at the Taiwan Institute of Economic Research, believes that the inflation problems in Europe and the United States have not been resolved this year, and demand continues to decline. He predicts that Taiwan’s export slump will persist throughout the first half of the year.

src: 由于台湾经济靠出口支撑，受出口低迷影响，全年经济增长表现将不如去年。
raw: Since Taiwan's economy is supported by exports, the annual economic growth will be weaker than last year due to the sluggish performance of exports.

src: 气球事件更擦亮美国眼睛？
raw: Did the balloon incident serve to make Americans more aware of the situation?

src: 加强限制技术出口到中国
raw: Strengthen restrictions on the export of technology to China

src: 据华尔街日报今天报道称，气球事件后，美国准备进一步收紧对华技术出口。
raw: According to a report in The Wall Street Journal today, following the balloon incident, the United States is preparing to further tighten restrictions on the export of technology to China.

src: 现任和前任安全官员表示，上述气球事件突显了中国构成的国家安全威胁，并将为加强美国技术保护争取更多政治支持。
raw: Current and former security officials have stated that the aforementioned balloon incident highlights the national security threat posed by China, and will help gain more political support for strengthening America’s technological defenses.

src: 美国称该气球携带了用于情报收集和通信的天线和传感器。
raw: The United States states that the balloon carried antennas and sensors used for intelligence gathering and communication.

src: 据前美国中央情报局高级官员、现供职于华盛顿智库新美国安全中心的Martijn Rasser说。
raw: According to Martijn Rasser, a former senior official of the US Central Intelligence Agency who now works at the Washington-based think tank New American Security Center:

src: “这无疑是火上浇油，支持了对华强硬派的观点”。
raw: “This is undoubtedly adding fuel to the fire, supporting the views of those who take a tough stance towards China.”

src: 白宫新闻秘书卡琳·让-皮埃尔(Karine Jean-Pierre)周四对记者表示，“我们还将考虑采取更大范围的行动，以揭露和应对中国更大规模的监视活动，这些活动对我们的国家安全以及我们的盟友和伙伴构成威胁。
raw: Karine Jean-Pierre, the White House press secretary, told reporters on Thursday, “We will also consider taking more extensive actions to expose and address the larger-scale surveillance activities conducted by China, which pose a threat to our national security as well as to our allies and partners.”

src: ”美国官员说，他们已向30多个国家的政府通报了上述气球事件的情况，国际协调对于应对中国威胁至关重要。
raw: “U.S. officials said that they have informed the governments of more than 30 countries about the aforementioned balloon incidents, and international coordination is crucial for responding to the threat posed by China.”

src: 战略与国际问题研究中心的高级研究员Emily Benso说，除了拜登政府的行动外，美国众议院新成立的美国与中国共产党战略竞争特设委员会也可能施压美国采取更严厉的措施来拖慢中国的发展。
raw: Emily Benso, a senior researcher at the Center for Strategic and International Studies, said that in addition to the actions of the Biden administration, the newly established U.S. House Committee on Strategic Competition with the Communist Party of China could also exert pressure on the United States to take more stringent measures to slow down China’s development.

src: 她说，国会议员将感受到越来越大的压力，要求他们采取更强硬的立场，而这又可能会迫使白宫采取更强硬的政策。
raw: She said that members of Congress will face increasing pressure to take a more aggressive stance, which in turn may force the White House to adopt even more stringent policies.

src: 华尔街日报称，许多主张更严格出口管制的人也在推动扩大管制范围，将人工智能等行业纳入其中。
raw: The Wall Street Journal reports that many advocates for stricter export controls are also pushing to expand the scope of these controls to include industries such as artificial intelligence.

src: 美国政府也已经在制定一项对外投资审查计划，审视美国在海外的投资是否存在来自中国的潜在国家安全威胁。
raw: The U.S. government is also developing a review program for foreign investments to assess whether U.S. investments overseas pose any potential national security threats from China.

src: 分析人士称，白宫可能会面临要求更快推出该计划的呼声。
raw: Analysts say that the White House may face calls for the plan to be implemented more quickly.

src: 首批个人养老金理财产品开售 最短可只持有360天-中新网
raw: The first batch of personal pension financial products is now on sale, with a minimum holding period of just 360 days – Sino-New Network

src: 首批个人养老金理财产品开售
raw: The first batch of personal pension financial products is now on sale.

src: 家机构的7只产品可选 最短可只持有360天
raw: There are 7 products available from this domestic institution to choose from, and the minimum holding period is only 360 days.

src: 个人养老金理财产品终于上线了。
raw: The personal pension financial products have finally been launched.

src: 2月10日，中国理财网发布首批个人养老金理财产品名单，工银理财、农银理财和中邮理财的7只个人养老金理财产品正式发售。
raw: On February 10, China Financial Management Network released the list of the first batch of personal pension financial products, with seven personal pension financial products from ICBC Financial Management, ABC Financial Management, and China Post Financial Management officially going on sale.

src: 至此，个人养老金账户的“货架”终于集齐个人养老金储蓄、个人养老金理财、个人养老金保险、个人养老金公募基金四类产品。
raw: Up to this point, the “shelf” of individual pension accounts has finally been completed with four types of products: individual pension savings, individual pension investment management services, individual pension insurance, and publicly offered individual pension funds.

src: 据介绍，首批个人养老金理财产品，全部为公募类净值型开放式产品，其中新发产品5只、存续产品2只，除1只产品为混合类产品外，其余6只产品均为固定收益类产品。
raw: According to the information provided, the first batch of personal pension financial products are all publicly offered, net-value, open-ended products. There are 5 newly issued products and 2 existing products. With the exception of one product which is a hybrid type, the remaining 6 products are all fixed-income products.

src: 北京青年报记者看到，5只新发产品中有4只来自工银理财，全部是固定收益类产品，最短持有期限分别为365天、540天、720天和1080天，对应的业绩比较基准(年化)分别为3.70 % - 4.20 % 、 4.10 % - 4.60 % 、 4.40 % - 4.90 % 、 5.25 % - 5.75 % 。
raw: Reporters from Beijing Youth Daily observed that among the five newly launched products, four were issued by ICBC Wealth Management. All of them are fixed-income products with holding periods of 365 days, 540 days, 720 days, and 1080 days, respectively. The corresponding annualized performance benchmarks range from 3.70% to 4.20%, 4.10% to 4.60%, 4.40% to 4.90%, and 5.25% to 5.75%, respectively.

src: 剩余一只新发产品是“邮银财富添颐·鸿锦最短持有1095 天 1 号 ” ， 也是固定收益类产品，2月10日开始募集，2月19日结束募集，风险等级为二级。
raw: The remaining new product is “Youyin Fortune Tianyi·Hongjin Minimum Holding Period of 1095 Days No. 1,” which is also a fixed-income product. The fundraising for this product began on February 10 and ended on February 19, with a risk rating of Level 2.

src: 两只存续产品中，一只是农银理财“农银同心·灵动”360天科技创新人民币理财产品，投资性质为混合类，风险等级为三级。
raw: Of the two remaining products, one is the Agricultural Bank of China’s financial product “Agricultural Bank of China Tongxin·Lingdong” 360-Day Technology Innovation RMB Financial Product, which has a mixed investment nature and a risk level of three.

src: 另一只存续产品是“邮银财富添颐·鸿锦最短持有365 天 1 号 ” ， 固定收益类型，去年12月30日开始募集，今年1月4日正式运作，2月8日的累计净值为1.0011。
raw: The other ongoing product is “Youyin Fortune Tianyi·Hongjin Minimum Holding Period of 365 Days No. 1,” which is a fixed-income type. It began fundraising on December 30 last year and officially started operating on January 4 this year. As of February 8, its cumulative net value was 1.0011.

src: 根据《国务院办公厅关于推动个人养老金发展的意见 》 ， 个人养老金资金账户资金可投资的金融产品包括银行理财、储蓄存款、商业养老保险、公募基金等。
raw: According to the "Opinions of the General Office of the State Council on Promoting the Development of Individual Pension Plans," the financial products into which funds in individual pension accounts can be invested include bank wealth management products, savings deposits, commercial pension insurance, and publicly offered funds.

src: 首批个人养老金理财产品发售，标志着个人养老金投资者可正式通过个人养老金资金账户购买理财产品。
raw: The launch of the first batch of personal pension financial products marks the official commencement of the ability for individual pension investors to purchase financial products through their personal pension fund accounts.

src: 去年11月银保监会制定了《商业银行和理财公司个人养老金业务管理暂行办法 》 。
raw: Last November, the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission (CBIRC) formulated the "Interim Measures for the Management of Personal Pension Business by Commercial Banks and Financial Planning Companies."

src: 《办法》规定，参加人可以通过个人养老金资金账户购买个人养老储蓄、个人养老金理财产品、个人养老金保险产品、个人养老金公募基金产品等个人养老金产品。
raw: The “Measures” stipulate that participants can purchase various personal pension products through their individual pension fund accounts, such as personal pension savings products, personal pension investment management products, personal pension insurance products, and publicly offered personal pension fund products.

src: 随后，人社部、财政部、国家税务总局三部门发布通知，明确个人养老金制度在北京、天津，以及河北石家庄、雄安新区，山西晋城市等36个先行城市和地区启动实施。
raw: Subsequently, three departments—the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, the Ministry of Finance, and the State Taxation Administration—issued a notice clarifying that the individual pension system is to be implemented in 36 pilot cities and regions, including Beijing, Tianjin, Shijiazhuang in Hebei Province, Xiongan New Area, and Jincheng in Shanxi Province.

src: 截至2022年底，个人养老金参加人数1954万人，缴费人数613万人，总缴费金额142亿元。
raw: As of the end of 2022, the number of individuals participating in the personal pension scheme was 19.54 million, with 6.13 million people making contributions, totaling 14.2 billion yuan in contributions.

src: 此前，参与试点的银行只上架了个人养老储蓄、个人养老金保险产品和个人养老金公募基金三类产品。
raw: Previously, the banks participating in the pilot only offered three types of products: personal pension savings, personal pension insurance products, and publicly offered personal pension funds.

src: 如今，个人养老金理财产品也聚齐之后，投资者该如何选择？
raw: Now that all the personal pension investment products are available, how should investors make their choices?

src: 交银理财产品研发部专家表示，相比其他个人养老金产品，试点阶段的养老理财产品和个人养老金理财产品均具有三方面的特点。
raw: Experts from the Product Research and Development Department of Bank of Communications stated that, compared to other individual pension products, the pension financial products in the pilot phase as well as the regular individual pension financial products possess three distinctive characteristics.

src: 一是稳健性，风险管理机制更加健全，投资策略和理念更为稳健，并实施非母行第三方独立托管。
raw: The first aspect is robustness: the risk management mechanisms have been improved, investment strategies and philosophies have become more prudent, and third-party independent custody is implemented by entities other than the parent bank.

src: 二是长期性，试点阶段养老理财产品的期限都在5年及以上，下一步发行的个人养老金理财产品，最短持有期原则上为1年，鼓励持有3年以上。
raw: The second aspect is the long-term nature: during the pilot phase, the duration of pension financial products was set at 5 years or more. For the personal pension financial products to be issued in the next step, the minimum holding period will be 1 year, with an encouragement to hold them for more than 3 years.

src: 三是普惠性，产品购买门槛低，起购点一般为1元，有的低至0.01元，产品的托管费、管理费等费率更加优惠。
raw: The third aspect is inclusivity: the threshold for purchasing products is low, with a minimum purchase amount generally being 1 yuan, and in some cases, it can be as low as 0.01 yuan. Additionally, the fees for product custody and management are more favorable.

src: 专业人士指出，投资者要根据产品特点和自己的风险承受能力进行选择。
raw: Experts point out that investors should make their choices based on the characteristics of the products and their own risk tolerance.

src: 个人养老金储蓄具有期限较长、利率较高、安全性高的特点，适合风险承受能力弱的人群；个人养老金保险产品重在保障，比较适合无法承担投资风险，可以接受稳定收益的人群；而个人养老金理财产品和公募基金产品不保本也不保收益，有一定投资风险，但预期收益较高，适合具备一定的金融知识、风险承担能力较高的人群。
raw: Personal pension savings are characterized by long maturity periods, high interest rates, and high safety levels, making them suitable for individuals with a low risk tolerance. Personal pension insurance products focus on providing protection and are more appropriate for those who cannot afford to take on investment risks but are willing to accept stable returns. On the other hand, personal pension investment products and publicly offered fund products do not guarantee the principal or returns; they carry certain investment risks but offer higher expected returns, making them suitable for individuals with some financial knowledge and a higher risk tolerance.

raw: The seminar for newly appointed members and alternate members of the Central Committee, as well as key leading cadres at the provincial and ministerial levels, to study and implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era and the spirit of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China has concluded.
2023-02-11 13:07:20 [Source: Xinhua News Agency] [Editor: Li Xufeng] Font size: [Large, Medium, Small]

src: 新华社北京2月10日电 新进中央委员会的委员、候补委员和省部级主要领导干部学习贯彻习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想和党的二十大精神研讨班10日下午在中央党校（国家行政学院）结业，中共中央政治局常委、中央书记处书记蔡奇出席结业式并作总结讲话。
raw: Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, February 10th: A seminar for newly appointed members of the Central Committee, alternate members of the Central Committee, and key leading cadres at the provincial and ministerial levels to study and implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era and the spirit of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China concluded on the afternoon of the 10th at the Central Party School (National Academy of Governance). Cai Qi, a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee, attended the closing ceremony and delivered a concluding speech.

src: 他表示，要深入学习贯彻习近平总书记在研讨班开班式上的重要讲话精神，更加坚定拥护“两个确立”、坚决做到“两个维护”，增强本领、真抓实干，扎实推进中国式现代化各项工作，在全面建设社会主义现代化国家、全面推进中华民族伟大复兴中创造经得起历史、实践和人民检验的业绩。
raw: He stated that it is necessary to thoroughly study and implement the spirit of the important speech delivered by General Secretary Xi Jinping at the opening ceremony of the seminar. We must more firmly uphold the “two establishments” (the establishment of Xi Jinping's core position in the Party and the Party Central Committee, and the establishment of the theory of socialism with Chinese characteristics for a new era) and resolutely achieve the “two upholds” (upholding General Secretary Xi Jinping's core position in the Party and the Party Central Committee, and upholding the Central Committee's authority and its centralized, unified leadership). We need to enhance our capabilities, take practical actions, and solidly advance all aspects of China's path to modernization. In doing so, we aim to achieve accomplishments that can stand the test of history, practice, and the people, as we work towards building a modern socialist country in all respects and advancing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

src: 研讨班期间，全体学员以习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想为指导，认真学习党的二十大精神和习近平总书记在研讨班开班式上的重要讲话，联系实际深入研讨交流，深化了对中国式现代化一系列重大理论和实践问题的认识，增强了在以习近平同志为核心的党中央坚强领导下以中国式现代化全面推进中华民族伟大复兴的信心和决心，增强了履职尽责、做好工作、确保新时代新征程良好开局的责任感和使命感。
raw: During the seminar, all participants were guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era. They earnestly studied the spirit of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the important speech delivered by General Secretary Xi Jinping at the opening ceremony of the seminar. By connecting theory with practice and engaging in in-depth discussions and exchanges, they deepened their understanding of a series of major theoretical and practical issues related to Chinese path to modernization. This enhanced their confidence and determination to advance the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation through Chinese path to modernization under the strong leadership of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core. It also strengthened their sense of responsibility and mission to fulfill their duties, perform their work well, and ensure a successful start to the new era and new journey.

src: 结业式上，研讨班10名代表发言，汇报交流了学习收获。
raw: At the graduation ceremony, 10 representatives from the seminar spoke, sharing their learning experiences and insights.

src: 蔡奇表示，学习贯彻习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想和党的二十大精神，既是当前和今后一个时期的首要政治任务，也是一项长期战略任务，要按照“全面学习、全面把握、全面落实”的要求，推动学习贯彻工作不断往深里走、往实里走、往心里走。
raw: Cai Qi stated that studying and implementing the thought of Xi Jinping on socialism with Chinese characteristics for a new era and the spirit of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China is not only the primary political task at present and for some time to come, but also a long-term strategic task. It is necessary to follow the requirements of “comprehensive learning, comprehensive understanding, and comprehensive implementation” to ensure that the work of study and implementation continues to deepen, become more practical, and take root in people’s minds.

src: 要更加深刻领悟“两个确立”的决定性意义，坚决维护习近平总书记的核心地位、维护党中央权威和集中统一领导，不断提高政治判断力、政治领悟力、政治执行力，始终在思想上政治上行动上同以习近平同志为核心的党中央保持高度一致。
raw: To more profoundly understand the decisive significance of the “two establishments,” we must resolutely uphold General Secretary Xi Jinping’s core position, as well as the authority and centralized, unified leadership of the Central Committee of the Party. We must continuously enhance our political judgment, understanding, and execution capabilities, and always maintain a high degree of consistency in our thoughts, politics, and actions with the Central Committee of the Party, with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core.

src: 要努力掌握好马克思主义理论这一看家本领，自觉用党的创新理论武装头脑、指导实践、推动工作，在深学、细悟、笃行上下功夫，真正学出坚定信念、学出绝对忠诚、学出使命担当。
raw: We must strive to master the theory of Marxism as our core competence, and consciously use the Party’s innovative theories to arm our minds, guide our practice, and advance our work. We need to put effort into in-depth study, careful comprehension, and earnest application of these theories, in order to truly develop firm beliefs, absolute loyalty, and a sense of mission and responsibility.

src: 要以奋发有为的精神状态贯彻落实好党的二十大各项决策部署，扎实推进中国式现代化，撸起袖子加油干，扑下身子当好“施工队长”，一步一个脚印把蓝图变为现实。
raw: We must implement the various decisions and arrangements of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China with a spirit of diligence and initiative, steadily advance China's path to modernization, roll up our sleeves and work hard, and take on the role of "construction team leaders" to turn the blueprint into reality step by step.

src: 要牢记全面从严治党永远在路上、党的自我革命永远在路上，压紧压实全面从严治党政治责任，以党的政治建设为统领，深入推进新时代党的建设新的伟大工程。
raw: It must be remembered that the comprehensive and strict governance of the Party is an ongoing process, as is the Party’s self-revolution. We must firmly uphold the political responsibilities associated with this governance, taking the Party’s political construction as the guiding principle, and vigorously advance the new great project of Party building in the new era.

src: 要增强推动高质量发展本领、服务群众本领、防范化解风险本领，大兴调查研究之风，坚决防止和克服形式主义、官僚主义。
raw: It is necessary to enhance the capabilities to promote high-quality development, to serve the people, and to prevent and resolve risks. We must foster a strong culture of investigation and research, and resolutely prevent and overcome formalism and bureaucracy.
