src: 东德最后一位共产党总理今去世
raw: The last communist prime minister of East Germany has passed away today.

src: 东德共产党的继任者在该党在一份声明中报告，“昨晚，汉斯·莫德罗 (Hans Modrow) 离开了我们，享年 95 岁。
raw: The successor to the Communist Party of East Germany reported in a statement: “Last night, Hans Modrow passed away from among us at the age of 95.”

src: 因此，我们的党失去了一位重要领导人。
raw: Therefore, our party has lost an important leader.
Chinese: “

src: 1989 年 11 月 13 日，在将东柏林和西柏林分开 28 年的柏林墙打开四天后，莫德罗曾表示他将帮助把东德变成一个民主国家。
raw: On November 13, 1989, four days after the fall of the Berlin Wall that had separated East Berlin from West Berlin for 28 years, Modrow stated that he would help transform East Germany into a democratic country.

src: 当时，由于东德各地的抗议者要求民主和自由，共产党领导人被迫下台。
raw: At that time, due to protests by people across East Germany demanding democracy and freedom, the leaders of the Communist Party were forced to step down.

src: 戈尔巴乔夫 (Mikhail Gorbachev) 在苏联上台后曾要求在苏联主导的东欧也进行变革。
raw: After coming to power in the Soviet Union, Mikhail Gorbachev called for reforms to be carried out in the Eastern Europe countries that were under Soviet influence as well.

src: 1990 年 3 月，莫德罗宣布德意志民主共和国 (GDR) 的第一次也是唯一一次自由选举。
raw: In March 1990, Modrow announced the first and only free elections in the German Democratic Republic (GDR).

src: 选举结果导致他不再担任总理。
raw: The results of the election led to his removal from the position of Prime Minister.

src: 尽管莫德罗进行了改革，但反对者指责他试图推迟 1990 年 10 月发生的政治变革和统一。
raw: Despite the reforms implemented by Modrow, his opponents accused him of trying to delay the political changes and reunification that took place in October 1990.

src: 他还因试图重塑而不是废除秘密警察而受到批评。
raw: He has also been criticized for attempting to restructure the secret police rather than abolish it.

src: 1993 年，莫德罗在 1989 年 5 月的市政选举中被判选举舞弊罪名成立，但并未入狱。
raw: In 1993, Modrow was found guilty of election fraud in the municipal elections of May 1989, but he was not imprisoned.

src: 有称这些指控是出于政治动机。
raw: Some claim that these accusations are motivated by political reasons.

src: 1990 年至 1994 年，莫德罗继续在德国议会任职，并于 1999 年至 2004 年担任欧洲议会议员。
raw: From 1990 to 1994, Modrow continued to serve in the German parliament, and from 1999 to 2004, he was a member of the European Parliament.

src: 莫德罗将自己视为一名改革者，并希望从内部改变共产党。
raw: Modrow sees himself as a reformer and hopes to change the Communist Party from within.

src: 1999 年，他告诉路透社，他不希望旧东德回归，但表示应该承认东德的成就。
raw: In 1999, he told Reuters that he did not want the former East Germany to be re-integrated, but stated that the achievements of East Germany should be recognized.

src: 莫德罗于 1928 年出生在当时的德国小镇 Jasenitz（现为波兰的 Jasienica），并接受过机械师培训。
raw: Modro was born in 1928 in the small German town of Jasenitz (now Jasienica in Poland) and received training as a mechanic.

src: 第二次世界大战期间，他担任青年消防队排长，并在冲突快结束时成为纳粹民兵组织 Volkssturm 的一员，该组织征召 16 至 60 岁的男子参加最后的战争挣扎。
raw: During World War II, he served as the platoon leader of a youth fire brigade. Near the end of the conflict, he became a member of the Nazi militia organization Volkssturm, which conscripted men aged 16 to 60 to participate in the final efforts of the war.

src: 17 岁时，莫德罗被苏联军队俘虏，作为战俘被带到苏联，在那里他参加了反法西斯课程，并成为一名坚定的共产党员。
raw: At the age of 17, Modro was captured by the Soviet army and taken to the Soviet Union as a prisoner of war. There, he attended anti-fascist training courses and became a committed Communist Party member.

src: 1949 年，即东德成立的那一年，他回国后找到了一份机械师的工作，并继续学习社会科学和经济学，并获得了博士学位。
raw: In 1949, the year East Germany was established, he returned to his home country and found a job as a mechanic. He continued to study social sciences and economics, and later obtained a doctorate degree.

src: 莫德罗是自由德国青年运动的一名工作人员，几乎所有东德年轻人都加入了该运动，并在 1973 年至 1989 年期间通过执政的社会统一党 (SED) 晋升为德累斯顿地区党的主席。
raw: Modrow was a member of the Free German Youth movement; virtually all young people in East Germany joined this movement. Between 1973 and 1989, he rose through the ranks to become the chairman of the party in the Dresden region, via the ruling Socialist Unity Party (SED).

src: 他还在东德任职议会超过 30 年。
raw: He also served in the parliament of East Germany for more than 30 years.

src: 1990 年莫德罗成为东德事实上的领导人，担任最高国家职务。
raw: In 1990, Modrow became the de facto leader of East Germany, holding the highest state office.

src: 越通社河内——越通社特派记者报道，越南政府总理范明政和夫妇对新加坡和文莱进行正式访问已圆满成功，并取得了全面、务实且具体的成果。
raw: Vietnam News Agency, Hanoi – A special correspondent from the Vietnam News Agency reports that the official visit of Vietnamese Prime Minister Phan Minh Chinh and his spouse to Singapore and Brunei has been a complete success, yielding comprehensive, practical, and concrete results.

src: 在出访新加坡和文莱的三天之内，范明政总理共参加了30多项不同的活动。
raw: During his three-day visit to Singapore and Brunei, Prime Minister Phan Minh Chinh participated in more than 30 different events.

src: 所取得的成效为促进越新两国战略伙伴关系和越文全面伙伴关系不断朝着更深、更广和有效的方向发展注入了新的动力。
raw: The achievements made have injected new momentum into the continuous development of the strategic partnership between Vietnam and New Zealand, as well as the comprehensive partnership between Vietnam and New Zealand, in a deeper, broader, and more effective direction.

src: 在访问两国期间，范明政总理继续重申越南党和国家的对外路线，即独立自主，多元化，多变化，愿做所有国家的好朋友和可靠伙伴，以及国际社会的负责任成员。
raw: During his visits to both countries, Prime Minister Phan Minh Chinh continued to reiterate Vietnam’s foreign policy approach, which emphasizes independence and autonomy, diversity, and flexibility. Vietnam aims to be a good friend and reliable partner of all nations, as well as a responsible member of the international community.

src: 加强与新加坡和文莱的关系是各自国家的需求，致力于增进各自国家人民的福祉，致力于地区和世界的和平、稳定和发展。
raw: Strengthening relations with Singapore and Brunei is in the interests of both countries, as it contributes to the well-being of their respective peoples and to regional and global peace, stability, and development.

src: 在各场会见和谈会上，范明政总理同新加坡和文莱领导人都一致同意通过高级代表团互访、有效开展各项双边合作机制和各项重要合作协议等方式不断增强与越南的政治互信。
raw: During various meetings and talks, Prime Minister Phan Minh Chinh and the leaders of Singapore and Brunei unanimously agreed to continuously enhance political mutual trust with Vietnam through reciprocal visits by high-level delegations, the effective implementation of various bilateral cooperation mechanisms, and the signing of important cooperation agreements.

src: 许多合作文件在此次访问期间得到了签署。
raw: Many cooperation documents were signed during this visit.

src: 其中，与新加坡签署的《绿色和数字经济伙伴关系谅解备忘录》和与文莱签署的《2023-2027年阶段加强越文全面伙伴关系的行动计划》是两大亮点。
raw: Among them, the "Memorandum of Understanding on a Partnership in the Green and Digital Economy" signed with Singapore, and the "Action Plan for Strengthening the Comprehensive Vietnam-Vietnam Partnership for the 2023-2027 Period" signed with Brunei, are the two main highlights.

src: 越南与新加坡签署《绿色和数字经济伙伴关系谅解备忘录》。
raw: Vietnam and Singapore sign a Memorandum of Understanding on a Partnership in the Green and Digital Economy.

src: 图自越通社

src: 在会见企业领导，座谈会或出席经济论坛期间，范明政总理强调越南欢迎并为新加坡和文莱企业在越南的数字化转型、绿色能源、高科技、创新创意等领域扩大投资范围创造便利条件。
raw: During meetings with corporate leaders, panel discussions, or attendance at economic forums, Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh emphasized that Vietnam welcomes and facilitates the expansion of investment by Singaporean and Bruneian companies in areas such as digital transformation, green energy, high technology, and innovation.

src: 此次访问不仅有助于深化越南与新加坡和文莱在政治、外交、经济、安全、国防、教育培训、油气、旅游、民间交流等各个传统领域上的合作关系，而且还为各国在数字经济、绿色经济、能源转型、创新创意、智慧城市、可持续发展等新的潜在领域创造合作框架。
raw: This visit not only helps to deepen the cooperative relations between Vietnam and Singapore as well as Brunei in various traditional areas such as politics, diplomacy, economy, security, national defense, education and training, oil and gas, tourism, and people-to-people exchanges, but also creates a framework for cooperation in new potential areas such as the digital economy, green economy, energy transition, innovation and creativity, smart cities, and sustainable development.

src: 文莱国王哈桑纳尔博尔基亚与范明政总理准备进入双边座谈会。
raw: Brunei Sultan Hassanal Bolkiah and Prime Minister Phan Minh Chinh are about to begin a bilateral discussion.

src: 在访问两国期间，范明政总理都安排时间走访和聆听旅居当地越南人社群的心思和愿望。
raw: During his visits to both countries, Prime Minister Phan Minh Chinh made time to meet with and listen to the concerns and aspirations of the Vietnamese communities living there.

src: 在两国领导人会见中，范明政总理都建议两国当局多关注，并为当地越南人社群得到公平的对待，有机会为当地社会贡献力量并培育两国关系等创造有利条件。
raw: During the meeting between the leaders of the two countries, Prime Minister Phan Minh Chinh advised the authorities of both nations to pay more attention to the situation and to create favorable conditions for the local Vietnamese communities to receive fair treatment. He also emphasized the importance of providing these communities with the opportunities to contribute to the local society and to foster the development of relations between the two countries.

src: 该建议都得到了两国领导人的同意和支持。
raw: Both suggestions were agreed upon and supported by the leaders of the two countries.

src: 特别的是，范明政总理还与两国领导人分享有关一个团结、和平、稳定和繁荣的东盟共同体的渴望；一致同意将与东盟国家保持团结协作并提升东盟在地区和国际形势复杂多变背景下的中心作用。
raw: In particular, Prime Minister Fan Mingzheng also shared with the leaders of both countries the desire for a cohesive, peaceful, stable, and prosperous ASEAN community. They agreed unanimously to maintain unity and cooperation with ASEAN countries and to enhance ASEAN’s central role in the context of the complex and dynamic regional and international situations.

src: 凭借所取得的重要成果，范明政总理对新加坡和文莱的正式访问之旅为有效落实越共十三大以加强与东盟邻国的关系为优先的对外路线，有效实施越共中央政治局关于新形势下越南侨务工作的第12号结论（12-KL/TW ），并发挥全民族团结力量等作出积极贡献。
raw: Thanks to the important achievements made, Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh’s official visits to Singapore and Brunei have made a positive contribution to the effective implementation of the Communist Party of Vietnam (CPV)’s foreign policy priorities as outlined at the 13th National Congress of the CPV, which focus on strengthening relations with ASEAN neighbors. These visits have also aided in the effective execution of Conclusion No. 12-KL/TW of the CPV Central Committee’s Political Bureau regarding the work of Vietnamese expatriates under the new circumstances, as well as in leveraging the strength of the entire national unity.

src: NEWS GOV-MO: 警情通告：司警局呼吁市民提防假冒电讯公司诈骗短讯
raw: NEWS FROM THE GOVERNMENT AND MINISTRY OF INTERNAL AFFAIRS: Police Alert: The Security Services Agency is urging the public to be wary of fraudulent text messages from fake telecommunications companies.

src: 近日司警局接获多宗电信诈骗案，不法分子假冒本澳电讯公司向事主发送附有网站连结的诈骗短信，以积分到期须尽快换领奖赏为饵，诱骗事主登入虚假网站进行兑换。
raw: Recently, the Police Intellectual Property Section has received several reports of telecommunications fraud cases. Criminals have impersonated local telecommunications companies to send fraudulent text messages to victims, containing links to fake websites. They lure the victims into logging in to these sites in order to claim rewards, under the pretense that the rewards are due to be claimed as soon as possible due to the expiration of their points.

src: 事主按指示输入信用卡资料及验证码，随即收到金融机构通知信用卡出现不明消费记录，怀疑信用卡资料经上述网站被盗取。
raw: The victim followed the instructions and entered their credit card information and verification code. Shortly thereafter, they received a notice from the financial institution stating that there were unauthorized transactions on their credit card, leading them to suspect that their credit card details had been stolen through the aforementioned website.

src: 经查，证实相关电讯公司并无发出上述短讯。
raw: Upon investigation, it was confirmed that the relevant telecommunications company did not send the aforementioned text messages.

src: 司警局呼吁市民，如接获类似手机短讯须提高警惕，切勿登入短讯所载网站连结或提供任何个人资料；若被要求提供信用卡资料、帐户交易密码、交易验证码，更要加倍谨慎，防止信用卡被盗刷。
raw: The police department is urging citizens to be vigilant if they receive similar text messages on their mobile phones. They should not click on the links contained in the messages or provide any personal information. If they are asked to provide credit card details, account transaction passwords, or transaction verification codes, they should be especially cautious to prevent their credit cards from being fraudulently used.

src: 防骗提示：
raw: Scam Prevention Tips:

src: 1. 多关注网络安全资讯，提高个人防范意识；
raw: 1. Pay more attention to cybersecurity news to enhance your personal awareness of prevention measures.

src: 2. 切勿随便登入来历不明的网站并在网站内登记个人及信用卡资料，以防遭人盗用；
raw: 2. Never log in to websites of unknown origin, and do not provide personal or credit card information on such websites to prevent it from being misused by others.

src: 3. 警惕假冒网站及钓鱼网站，时刻留意网站网址是否与官方网站完全相符；
raw: 3. Be wary of fake websites and phishing sites, and always check whether the website address matches the official website address exactly.

src: 4. 为手机、移动装置或电脑安装防毒软件，并定期更新；
raw: 4. Install antivirus software on your mobile phone, mobile device, or computer, and update it regularly.

src: 5. 怀疑遇到诈骗或其他犯罪时，应立即致电司警局防诈骗查询热线8800 7777或报案热线993求助。
raw: 5. If you suspect you have been the victim of fraud or any other crime, you should immediately call the SIA's Fraud Prevention Inquiry Hotline at 8800 7777 or the Report a Crime Hotline at 993 for assistance.

src: 欧盟峰会为难民政策争论，欧盟官员：接收过程步步瓶颈-中新网
raw: EU summit highlights debate over refugee policy; EU officials: The asylum process is facing numerous obstacles – Sino-New Network

src: 欧盟峰会为难民政策争吵不休，欧盟官员：接收过程每一步都存在瓶颈
raw: The EU summit was marked by intense arguments over refugee policies, with EU officials stating that there are bottlenecks at every step of the reception process.

src: 【环球时报驻比利时特派记者 牛瑞飞】据法新社2月10日报道，在当天最新的一次欧盟峰会上，欧盟委员会主席冯德莱恩表示，欧盟领导人同意就非法移民问题出台更严格的政策，以此更易于驱逐非法移民。
raw: 【Global Times correspondent in Belgium, Niu Ruifei】According to a report by AFP on February 10, at the latest EU summit of that day, EU Commission President Ursula von der Leyen stated that EU leaders agreed to adopt stricter policies regarding illegal immigration in order to make it easier to deport such individuals.

src: 据报道，欧盟此举是对欧洲日益增长的非法移民问题关注的回应，如今，欧盟的核心问题在于，最终能被遣返的非法移民人数很少。
raw: According to reports, the EU’s action is in response to the growing issue of illegal immigration in Europe. The main problem now is that the number of illegal immigrants who can ultimately be repatriated is very low.

src: 根据峰会文件，欧盟领导人呼吁委员会“立即调动大量欧盟资金”，以基础设施和监视等手段加强外部边界。
raw: According to the summit documents, EU leaders called on the committee to “immediately allocate a significant amount of EU funds” in order to strengthen the external borders through measures such as infrastructure improvement and surveillance.

src: 然而，欧盟与各成员国就围栏费用支付等问题争吵不休。
raw: However, the EU and its member states have been constantly arguing over issues such as the payment for the construction of the fences.

src: 冯德莱恩一再表示，欧盟资金不会支付相关费用。
raw: Fondelain has repeatedly stated that EU funds will not be used to cover the relevant costs.

src: 但一些成员国的外交官员称，如果欧盟能分担外部边界沿线安装摄像头、瞭望塔和其他基础设施的部分，这将给各国腾出国家预算从而加快建设进程。
raw: However, diplomats from some member states have stated that if the EU could share the cost of installing cameras, watchtowers, and other infrastructure along the external borders, it would free up national budgets, thereby accelerating the construction process.

src: 欧洲Euractiv网站称，欧盟官员承认，难民接收过程每一步都存在瓶颈，有限的接收能力和成员国不堪重负的移民当局无法阻止难民在欧盟各国提交“无数”庇护申请，欧盟的难民接收系统处于近乎“永久性的危机”中。
raw: According to the European website Euractiv, EU officials acknowledge that there are bottlenecks at every stage of the refugee reception process. The limited capacity for reception, coupled with the overwhelmed immigration authorities in member states, are unable to prevent refugees from submitting “innumerable” asylum applications across the EU. As a result, the EU’s refugee reception system is in a state of near-permanent crisis.

src: 据欧盟委员会估计，欧盟的申根国家去年收到超92万份庇护申请，比前一年增加近半。
raw: According to estimates by the European Commission, the Schengen countries within the EU received more than 920,000 asylum applications last year, an increase of nearly 50% compared to the previous year.

src: 与此同时，欧盟去年记录到超 33万次非法入境。
raw: Meanwhile, the EU recorded more than 330,000 illegal crossings last year.

src: 在该背景下，此次峰会还就一项“原则”达成协议，即欧盟国家可根据另一个成员国的法院判决将非法移民遣返回国。
raw: In this context, the summit also reached an agreement on a “principle” according to which EU countries may return illegal immigrants to their home country based on a court judgment from another member state.

src: 此外，报道称，欧盟领导人还同意“增加对安全国家概念的使用”，这将为欧盟制定共同清单开辟道路。
raw: Additionally, the reports state that EU leaders also agreed to “increase the use of the concept of ‘safe countries’,” which will pave the way for the EU to establish a common list of such countries.

src: (来源：环球时报 作者：牛瑞飞)
raw: Chinese: (Source: Global Times, Author: Niu Ruifei)

src: 国民党副主席夏立言访中传达宋涛语：九二共识下欢迎绿营访陆
raw: Xia Liyan, Vice Chairman of the Kuomintang, visited China to convey Song Tao’s message: Under the 1992 Consensus, visits from the Green Movement to the Chinese mainland are welcome.

src: 台湾中国国民党副主席夏立言今次访中先后会见中国国台办主任宋涛与中共中央政治局常委王沪宁。
raw: Hsieh Li-yen, the vice chairman of the Kuomintang (KMT) in Taiwan, met with Song Tao, the director of the Taiwan Affairs Office of China, and Wang Huning, a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China (CPC), during his recent visit to China.

src: 国民党官方机构国政基金会资深顾问赵春山昨天晚上接受台湾中央社采访，积极评价宋涛对夏立言所说，只要认同“九二共识”与反台独，中国欢迎绿营人士到访大陆。
raw: Zhao Chunshan, a senior advisor to the Kuomintang’s official organization, the National Policy Foundation, was interviewed by Taiwan Central News Agency last night. He gave a positive response to what Song Tao said regarding Hsieh Li-yen: as long as people agree with the “1992 Consensus” and oppose Taiwan independence, China welcomes people from the Green Movement to visit the Chinese mainland.

src: 国民党方面评价认为是新鲜事物。
raw: The Nationalist Party views it as something new and innovative.

src: 夏立言稍早会见宋涛当日新闻没有提及此说法。
raw: The news from the day of Xia Liyan’s earlier meeting with Song Tao did not mention this claim.

src: 台湾执政的民进党连日澄清拒绝接受“九二共识”。
raw: The ruling Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) in Taiwan has repeatedly clarified that it refuses to accept the '1992 Consensus'.

src: 据中央社今天称，国民党副主席夏立言率团访陆，在北京期间，分别会见中共中央政治局常委王沪宁、新任国台办主任宋涛，与北京市委书记尹力。
raw: According to Xinhua News Agency today, Hsieh Li-yen, the vice chairman of the Kuomintang, led a delegation on a visit to the Chinese mainland. During his stay in Beijing, he met with Wang Huning, a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, the newly appointed Director of the Taiwan Affairs Office, Song Tao, and Yin Li, the secretary of the Beijing Municipal Party Committee.

src: 夏立言与宋涛会面谈到国共的政治基础是“九二共识”与反台独，国民党国政基金会资深顾问赵春山则在会中表示，国民党的“九二共识”是原汁原味的“九二共识”。
raw: Xia Liyan and Song Tao discussed during their meeting that the political foundation between the Kuomintang (KMT) and the Communist Party of China is the 1992 Consensus and the joint stance against Taiwan independence. Zhao Chunshan, a senior advisor to the KMT’s National Policy Foundation, stated at the meeting that the KMT’s version of the 1992 Consensus is the authentic and unaltered version of the agreement.

src: 赵春山分析，这与前几次参与的会议感受不同。
raw: Zhao Chunshan analyzed that this was different from the feelings he had during previous meetings he attended.

src: 近期与大陆学界视讯座谈，以及这次的座谈，没有听到涉台学者讲武统与“反分裂法”，取而代之的是恢复交流与对话。
raw: During recent video discussions with scholars from the Chinese mainland, as well as this particular discussion, I did not hear any scholars discussing the topic of military unification or the “Anti-Secession Law.” Instead, the focus was on the restoration of exchanges and dialogue.

src: 赵春山指出，两岸兵凶战危，中国大陆盼能透过国民党转达改善关系的意向。
raw: Zhao Chunshan pointed out that the situation across the Taiwan Strait is one of hostility and danger, and the Chinese mainland hopes to convey its desire to improve relations through the Kuomintang.

src: 因为民共之间没有互信，对方仍愿做好对台湾人工作，代表不希望两岸关系搞坏。
raw: Since there is no mutual trust between the CCP and the opposition parties, the latter is still willing to do their best to address the concerns of the Taiwanese people. This indicates that the representatives do not want the cross-strait relations to deteriorate.

src: 据赵春山也说，王沪宁也亲自下指示向宋涛讲“他们（台湾农渔民）提的要求，你们一定要落实”，若无法通盘解决，也要采个案处理。
raw: According to Zhao Chunshan, Wang Huning also personally gave instructions, telling Song Tao, “The demands made by them (Taiwanese farmers and fishermen) must be fulfilled. If it’s not possible to resolve the issue comprehensively, then individual cases should be dealt with on a case-by-case basis.”

src: 该报道没有提及国民党人访大陆是否当面提及中国军机军舰每日扰台，台湾少数县市的农渔问题，以及中央社记者采访是否提问此类问题。
raw: The report does not mention whether the Kuomintang representatives discussed on the mainland the daily disturbances caused by Chinese military aircraft and ships to Taiwan, the agricultural and fishing issues in a few Taiwanese counties and cities, or whether the Central News Agency reporters asked such questions during their interviews.

src: 阿拉斯加上空被击落的 “物体”究竟是什么？
raw: What exactly was that “object” that was shot down over Alaska?

src: 扑朔迷离，猜测纷纷
raw: Confusing and full of speculation

src: 美国军方周五（2月10日）下午再次动用美国最先进的隐身喷气战机F-22击落了一个在美国阿拉斯加上空飞行的尚未确定身份的物体。
raw: On Friday afternoon (February 10), the U.S. military once again utilized its most advanced stealth jet fighter, the F-22, to shoot down an unidentified object that was flying over Alaska.

src: 击落的地点距离阿拉斯加海岸十英里。
raw: The location where it was downed is ten miles from the coast of Alaska.

src: 这是美军在不到一周的时间里第二次击落空中飞行物体。
raw: This is the second time in less than a week that the U.S. military has shot down an object flying in the air.

src: 上周六，来自中国的一个间谍气球在美国领空上漂移数日后在美国南卡罗莱纳州沿岸附近上空被击毁。
raw: Last Saturday, a spy balloon from China drifted over U.S. territory for several days before being destroyed over the coast of South Carolina.

src: 五角大楼说，第二个被击落的物体于周四晚上首次进入美国领空，在阿拉斯加东北部上空移动时被美国军方跟踪，飞行高度为1.2万米（4万英尺），其大小与一辆小型汽车差不多，与先前被击落的那个中国间谍气球相比要小很多。
raw: The Pentagon stated that the second object that was shot down first entered U.S. airspace on Thursday evening and was tracked by the U.S. military as it moved over northeastern Alaska at an altitude of 12,000 meters (40,000 feet). Its size was comparable to that of a small car, making it much smaller than the previous Chinese spy balloon that had been shot down.

src: 五角大楼还认为，目前没有迹象显示，这个物体是可操纵的。
raw: The Pentagon also believes that there is currently no indication that the object can be controlled.

src: 白宫国家安全委员会战略沟通协调员约翰·科比周五表示，虽然这个在高空飞行的物体的具体样子尚不清楚，但它“对民航飞机的安全构成了合理的威胁”。
raw: John Kirby, the coordinator for strategic communications at the White House National Security Council, said on Friday that although the exact nature of the object flying at high altitudes is still unclear, it “poses a reasonable threat to the safety of civil aircraft.”

src: 科比表示，这个物体与美国境内发现的那个间谍气球不同，它上面没有悬挂“有效载荷”。
raw: Kobe stated that this object is different from the spy balloon found in the United States, as it does not have any “useful payload” hanging from it.

src: 科比说，“我们把它称为一个‘物体’是我们目前能够作出的最好的描述”。
raw: Kobe said, “Calling it an ‘object’ is the best description we have at the moment.”

src: 拜登总统在下令击落这个物体之前听取了五角大楼的建议，他作出这个决定的时候“非常谨慎”，科比补充说。
raw: President Biden listened to the advice of the Pentagon before ordering the object to be shot down, and he made this decision “with great caution,” Kobe added.

src: 美国官方对这个物体的描述大致可以归纳为：大小相当于一辆小汽车，没有操纵杆，没有悬挂装置，飞行高度为一万米左右。
raw: The official description from the United States for this object can be summarized as follows: It is about the size of a small car, has no control rods, no suspension system, and flies at an altitude of around ten thousand meters.

src: 但这些信息还无法回答基本问题，比如这个物体究竟是什么东西，它属于哪个国家，它在执行什么任务。
raw: But this information still doesn’t answer basic questions, such as what exactly this object is, which country it belongs to, or what task it is performing.

src: 目前网上许多的分析和猜测认为，这可能又是一只中国气球。
raw: Many analyses and speculations on the internet currently suggest that this could be another Chinese balloon.

src: 它可能与入侵美国领空的那只间谍气球和在拉美上空飘动的那只中国气球一样都来自中国，它们在不同地点执行某种任务。
raw: It may have originated from China, just like the spy balloon that invaded U.S. airspace and the Chinese balloon that was floating over Latin America; both were likely performing some mission in different locations.

src: 也有人把阿拉斯加的这个“物体”与“不明飞行物”（UFO）联系在一起。
raw: Some people also associate this object in Alaska with Unidentified Flying Objects (UFOs).

src: 美国新闻周刊的报道引用美国前众议员彼得·梅杰（Peter Meijer）周五在推特上发出的推文说，“真希望这个‘不明飞行物’也是一个间谍气球，而不是一个合法的UFO”。
raw: A report in Newsweek cited a tweet posted by former U.S. Representative Peter Meijer on Twitter on Friday, which read: “I really hope this ‘unidentified flying object’ turns out to be a spy balloon, rather than a legitimate UFO.”

src: “将外星飞船与气象气球混为一谈的讽刺意味很令人惊讶，但这不值得引发一场星际冲突，”梅杰说。
raw: “The irony of mistaking an alien spacecraft for a weather balloon is quite surprising, but it’s not worth triggering an interstellar conflict over such a matter,” said Major.

src: 梅杰是在科比证实阿拉斯加的这个物体被击落之后不久发出这个推文的。
raw: Mager posted this tweet shortly after Kobe confirmed that the object in Alaska had been shot down.

src: 新闻周刊说，怀疑这个物体是UFO的不止是梅杰一人。
raw: Newsweek says that Major is not the only one who suspects that the object could be a UFO.

src: 田纳西共和党籍众议员蒂姆·伯切特（Tim Burchett）批评政府上个月的掩盖情报的做法，要求国家情报总监办公室 (DNI)公布有关“不明飞行物”的报告。
raw: Tim Burchett, a Republican congressman from Tennessee, criticized the government's attempt to conceal information last month and called on the Office of the Director of National Intelligence (DNI) to release reports regarding unidentified flying objects (UFOs).

src: 新华社北京2月10日电 中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平2月9日给第19批援助中非共和国的中国医疗队队员回信，向他们以及广大援外医疗队员致以问候并提出殷切期望。
raw: Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, February 10th: Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the Communist Party of China (CPC), President of the People’s Republic of China, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, replied on February 9th to the members of the 19th batch of Chinese medical teams dispatched to assist the Central African Republic. He extended greetings to them and to all medical personnel involved in international aid efforts, and expressed his earnest hopes for their work.

src: 习近平在回信中说，你们在中非克服工作生活上的困难，用心服务当地民众，既是救死扶伤的白衣天使，也是传递情谊的友好使者。
raw: In his reply, Xi Jinping said: "You have overcome the difficulties in your work and life in China and Africa, and you have dedicated yourselves to serving the local people. You are not only angels in white who save lives and heal the wounded, but also friendly envoys who convey goodwill."

src: 今年是中国援外医疗队派遣60周年，谨向正在和曾经执行援外医疗任务的同志们致以诚挚的慰问。
raw: This year marks the 60th anniversary of the dispatch of China’s medical aid teams abroad. I would like to extend my sincere condolences to all comrades who are currently or have previously participated in these medical aid missions.

src: 习近平指出，中国人民热爱和平、珍视生命，援外医疗就是生动的体现。
raw: Xi Jinping stated that the Chinese people love peace and cherish life, and medical aid to other countries is a vivid manifestation of this.

src: 希望你们不忘初心、牢记使命，大力弘扬不畏艰苦、甘于奉献、救死扶伤、大爱无疆的中国医疗队精神，以仁心仁术造福当地人民，以实际行动讲好中国故事，为推动构建人类卫生健康共同体作出更大贡献。
raw: I hope that you will never forget your original aspirations and always keep your mission in mind. You should vigorously promote the spirit of the Chinese medical team, which is characterized by fearlessness in the face of difficulties, willingness to contribute, a commitment to saving lives and healing the wounded, and boundless compassion. Bring benefits to the local people with kindness and medical expertise, and tell China’s story through concrete actions. Make even greater contributions to promoting the establishment of a global community for human health and well-being.

src: 援外医疗是我国援外工作的重要内容。
raw: Medical assistance to other countries is an important part of our foreign aid efforts.

src: 1963年，我国向阿尔及利亚派出第一支援外医疗队。
raw: In 1963, our country sent its first medical team abroad to Algeria for assistance.

src: 60年来，累计向非洲、亚洲、美洲、欧洲和大洋洲的76个国家和地区派遣医疗队员3万人次，诊治患者2.9亿人次，赢得国际社会广泛赞誉。
raw: Over the past 60 years, a total of 30,000 medical personnel have been dispatched to 76 countries and regions in Africa, Asia, the Americas, Europe, and Oceania. They have treated 290 million patients, earning widespread praise from the international community.

src: 目前，援外医疗队在全球56个国家的115个医疗点工作，其中近一半在偏远艰苦地区。
raw: Currently, the foreign aid medical teams are working at 115 medical facilities in 56 countries around the world, with nearly half of them located in remote and difficult areas.

src: 近日，第19批援中非中国医疗队的11名队员给习近平总书记写信，汇报学习贯彻党的二十大精神、为当地民众提供医疗服务等情况，表达为推动构建人类卫生健康共同体贡献力量的决心。
raw: Recently, 11 members of the 19th Chinese medical team dispatched to Central Africa wrote a letter to General Secretary Xi Jinping, reporting on their efforts to study and implement the spirit of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, as well as on providing medical services to the local population. They expressed their determination to contribute to the establishment of a global community for human health and well-being.

src: 伊朗纪念革命周年 支持抗议的黑客骇了总统电视讲话
raw: Iran is commemorating the anniversary of its revolution; hackers supporting the protests hacked the president’s televised speech.

src: 伊朗伊斯兰共和国周六举行官方集会纪念伊朗革命 44 周年，但反政府黑客短暂打断了总统易卜拉欣·莱西的电视讲话。
raw: The Islamic Republic of Iran held an official gathering on Saturday to commemorate the 44th anniversary of the Iranian Revolution, but anti-government hackers briefly interrupted President Ebrahim Raisi’s televised speech.

src: 总统的电视直播讲话在互联网上被中断了大约一分钟，屏幕上出现了一群反伊朗政府黑客的标志，他们的名字是“Edalat Ali（阿里正义）”。
raw: The president’s live television speech was interrupted for about a minute on the internet; during that time, a logo belonging to a group of anti-Iranian hackers appeared on the screen. The hackers are known as “Edalat Ali (Ali of Justice)”.

src: 还出现有一个声音高喊“伊斯兰共和国去死”。
raw: There was also a voice shouting, “Die, Islamic Republic!”

src: 据路透社今天报道称，伊朗纪念革命周年，黑客中断国家电视台报道。
raw: According to a report by Reuters today, as Iran marked the anniversary of its revolution, hackers interrupted the broadcasts of the national television station.

src: 伊朗官方纪念伊朗革命 44 周年，莱西的强硬派政府面临着要求他们下台的年轻抗议者提出的最大胆的挑战，但莱西仍然呼吁“受骗的青年”悔改，这样他们才能得到伊朗最高领导人的赦免。
raw: Iran officially marks the 44th anniversary of the Iranian Revolution. The hard-line government in Leshi faces the boldest challenges from young protesters who are demanding its overthrow. Nevertheless, Leshi continues to call on the “deceived youth” to repent, so that they may receive forgiveness from the country’s supreme leader.

src: 22 岁的阿米尼 Mahsa Amini 于 9 月在该国道德警察的拘禁中死亡后，全国范围内的抗议活动席卷仍然在伊朗。
raw: Protests continue to sweep Iran across the country following the death of 22-year-old Amineh Mahsa Amini in September while in custody of the country’s moral police.

src: 伊朗安全部队对抗议活动进行致命镇压，这是伊斯兰共和国自 1979 年革命推翻 2500 年君主制以来面临的最强大挑战之一。
raw: The Iranian security forces have used deadly force to suppress the protests, which represent one of the most serious challenges faced by the Islamic Republic since the 1979 revolution overthrew the 2,500-year-old monarchy.

src: 作为纪念革命周年大赦的一部分，伊朗当局于周五释放了绝食抗议的被监禁的持不同政见者法哈德·梅萨米和伊朗-法国学者法里巴·阿德尔哈。
raw: As part of an amnesty commemorating the anniversary of the revolution, Iranian authorities released on Friday the imprisoned dissident Farhad Mesami, who was on a hunger strike, as well as the Iranian-French scholar Fariba Adelha.

src: 稍早最高领袖阿亚图拉·阿里·哈梅内伊 (Ayatollah Ali Khamenei) 发布了一项大赦令，其中包括一些在最近的反政府抗议活动中被捕的囚犯。
raw: Earlier on, the supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, issued a general amnesty that included some of the prisoners who were arrested during the recent anti-government protests.

src: 据人权组织 HRANA 报告，截至周五，已有 528 名抗议者被杀，其中包括 71 名未成年人。
raw: According to a report by the human rights organization HRANA, as of Friday, 528 protesters had been killed, including 71 minors.

src: 报告说，还有 70 名政府安全人员被打死。
raw: The report also states that 70 government security personnel were killed.

src: 据信，多达 19,763 名抗议者被捕。
raw: It is believed that as many as 19,763 protesters were arrested.

src: 数周以来，伊朗领导人和官方媒体一直呼吁在星期六的集会上进行投票，以表明反对抗议活动以及支持政府。
raw: For several weeks, Iranian leaders and official media have been calling for a vote to take place at the gathering on Saturday, in order to demonstrate opposition to the protests and support for the government.

src: 在周五晚上的伊朗革命周年纪念日晚上，官方媒体展示了烟花作为政府赞助庆祝活动的一部分，人们高呼“Allahu Akbar！
raw: On the evening of the anniversary of the Iranian Revolution, on Friday night, official media showed fireworks as part of government-sponsored celebration events. People shouted “Allahu Akbar!”

src: （上帝是最伟大的！）”。
raw: (God is the greatest!)

src: 然而，集会中也可以听到许多人大喊“独裁者去死！
raw: However, at the gathering, it was also possible to hear many people shouting, “Die, dictator!”

src: ” 以及社交媒体上发布的视频中的“伊斯兰共和国之死”。
raw: “And the phrase ‘Death of the Islamic Republic’ that appears in the videos posted on social media.”

src: 周六，政府电视台播出了全国各州官方集会的现场录像。
raw: On Saturday, the government television station broadcast live videos of official gatherings in various states across the country.

src: 在德黑兰，作为官方庆祝活动的一部分，展示了国产反弹道导弹、无人机、反潜巡洋舰和其他军事装备。
raw: In Tehran, as part of the official celebrations, domestically produced ballistic missiles, drones, anti-submarine cruisers, and other military equipment were displayed.

src: 总统莱西的演讲经常被“美国去死”的口号打断——这是州集会上的标志性口号。
raw: President Lacey’s speeches were often interrupted by the slogan “America, die!”, which has become a symbol of these state rallies.

src: 人群还高呼“以色列去死”。
raw: The crowd also shouted, “Death to Israel.”

raw: According to Reuters, Adelkhah, who has been in prison since 2019, is one of seven French nationals detained in Iran. This is one of the factors that have contributed to the deterioration of relations between Paris and Tehran in recent months.

src: 她于 2020 年因国家安全罪名被判处五年徒刑。
raw: She was sentenced to five years in prison in 2020 on charges related to national security.

src: 他们后来将她软禁在家，但在一月份她又回到了监狱。
raw: They later placed her under house arrest, but in January she returned to prison.

raw: Adelkhah denied these accusations.

src: 而梅萨米获释一周前，支持者警告说，他因绝食抗议而面临死亡风险。
raw: And a week before Mesamie was released, his supporters warned that he was at risk of dying due to his hunger strike protest.

src: 他于 2018 年因抗议强制戴头巾而被捕。
raw: He was arrested in 2018 for protesting the mandatory wearing of headscarves.

src: 法国外交部周五应对Adelkhah 获释，呼吁恢复她的自由，“包括如果她愿意，应当允许她返回法国。

src: 重阳问答︱如何看待美国1月非农就业数据大超预期及未来趋势 - 经济观察网 － 专业财经新闻网站
raw: Chongyang Q&A: How to View the Surprising Strength of January’s Non-Farm Employment Data in the US and Its Future Trends – Economic Observation Network, a Professional Financial News Website

src: Q：请问重阳投资，如何看待美国1月非农就业数据大超预期及未来趋势？
raw: Q: Regarding Chongyang Investment, how do they view the significantly better-than-expected non-farm employment data in the United States in January and the future trends?

src: A：2月3日美国劳工部公布2023年1月非农就业数据，新增非农就业51.7万人，大幅高于市场预期的18.9万人；失业率降至3.4%，为近50年以来的最低位；时薪同比增速4.4%，环比增速0.3%，略有放缓。
raw: On February 3, the U.S. Department of Labor released the non-farm employment data for January 2023. The number of new non-farm jobs created was 517,000, significantly higher than the market expectation of 189,000; the unemployment rate dropped to 3.4%, the lowest level in nearly 50 years; the hourly wage growth rate increased by 4.4% year-on-year and by 0.3% month-on-month, showing a slight slowdown.

src: 从总量上来看，本次数据存在很多一次性和技术性因素的扰动，比如罢工返岗的教职工、调查统计口径的修正、季调因子的更新，后续可能将有所修正（参考2022年1月新增非农由50.4万人下修至36.4万人），非农就业或不像数据体现的那样强劲。
raw: Overall, there are many one-time and technical factors that have influenced these numbers, such as teachers and staff returning to work after strikes, adjustments to the survey methodology, and updates to seasonal adjustment factors. Subsequent revisions may be made (for example, in January 2022, the number of non-farm jobs was revised downward from 504,000 to 364,000), indicating that non-farm employment may not be as strong as the data suggests.

src: 从结构上来看，高科技企业裁员影响仍在，但占比较低；高接触性服务业如休闲酒店、教育保健等新增就业大幅回升，数据显示服务业劳动力缺口仍存。
raw: From a structural perspective, the impact of layoffs in high-tech companies is still present, although the proportion is low. Employment in high-contact service sectors such as leisure hospitality and education and healthcare has rebounded significantly, indicating that there remains a labor shortage in the service industry.

src: 结合同样大超预期的服务业PMI、岗位空缺和劳动力缺口数据的回升和消费信贷数据的强势，我们判断经过极端天气和节假日后美国服务业迎来了快速修复。
raw: Combined with the rebound in data on the service sector PMI (which also exceeded expectations), as well as data on job vacancies and labor shortages, and the strong performance of consumer credit figures, we conclude that the U.S. service sector has experienced a rapid recovery following the extreme weather and holiday periods.

src: 我们认为，在不经过衰退的情况下美国就业市场的供需紧张难以改善。
raw: We believe that the supply-demand imbalance in the U.S. job market will not improve without going through a recession.

src: 目前美国劳动力市场尚有500余万的供给缺口，而劳动参与率上行缓慢，尤其是25-54岁劳动参与率已经接近疫情前高点。
raw: Currently, there is a supply gap of more than 5 million workers in the U.S. labor market, and the rate of labor participation is increasing slowly. In particular, the labor participation rate among people aged 25 to 54 has already approached its pre-pandemic peak.

src: 除此之外，由于美国居民超额储蓄和消费信贷的强势，消费需求的强劲将促使紧缩政策对就业市场的影响进一步滞后。
raw: In addition, due to the high levels of excess savings among U.S. residents and the strong performance of consumer credit, the strong demand for consumption will further delay the impact of austerity policies on the job market.

src: 美国就业市场供需持续紧张将是2023年美国经济的底色。
raw: The ongoing tight supply and demand in the U.S. job market will be a defining feature of the U.S. economy in 2023.

src: 叠加目前临近加息结束，通胀预期不断反复，我们对薪资增速的持续下降并不乐观。
raw: With the upcoming end of the interest rate hike cycle and the continuous fluctuations in inflation expectations, we are not optimistic about the continued decline in wage growth.

src: 本次数据公布前，美国股债汇市场对于美联储加息路径的预期过于乐观。
raw: Prior to the release of these data, the U.S. stock, bond, and currency markets were overly optimistic about the path of interest rate hikes by the Federal Reserve.

src: 随着通胀数据的持续改善，美联储在缩短加息步伐的同时还不断维系着市场通胀预期脆弱的平衡，但市场对于美联储偏向鹰派的表述视而不见，不仅预期提前停止加息，还预期年末两次降息。
raw: As inflation data continues to improve, the Federal Reserve has been slowing down the pace of interest rate hikes while also maintaining a fragile balance in market inflation expectations. However, the market ignores the Fed’s more hawkish stance, anticipating not only an early cessation of rate hikes but also two interest rate cuts by the end of the year.

src: 在劳动力市场供需紧张，紧缩政策影响不明的情况下，我们认为美联储年末对于加息的指引是相对合理的，市场极端预期的调整和交易的拥挤或将对市场产生一定伤害。
raw: In a situation where the supply and demand in the labor market are tight, and the effects of austerity policies are uncertain, we believe that the Federal Reserve’s guidance on interest rate hikes at the end of the year is relatively reasonable. However, adjustments to market expectations that are too extreme, as well as overcrowding in trading activities, could potentially cause some harm to the market.

src: 尽管如此，薪资增速的顽固难改当前通胀快速下降的趋势，随着M2数据同比转负以及各个CPI分项领先指标的逐渐转好，自10月份以来美国CPI数据已经转向快速下降阶段，薪资增速的顽固仅会对以后的通胀数据形成托底，当前的市场预期难以证伪，在下一期通胀数据公布后市场或进入新一轮博弈。
raw: Despite this, the stubbornly high pace of wage growth is not sufficient to reverse the current trend of rapidly declining inflation. As the M2 data has turned negative year-on-year and various leading indicators for the CPI have gradually improved, U.S. CPI data has entered a phase of rapid decline since October. The persistent high wage growth will only provide support for future inflation figures. The current market expectations are difficult to refute, and the market may enter a new round of speculation after the next set of inflation data is released.

src: 深圳：打造国内第一、世界领先的极速先锋城市-中新网

src: 中新网2月11日电 据“深圳工信”微信公众号10日消息，深圳市工业和信息化局近日印发《深圳市极速先锋城市建设行动计划》。
raw: China News Service, February 11th: According to a message on the WeChat official account “Shenzhen Industry and Information Technology” on the 10th, the Shenzhen Municipal Bureau of Industry and Information Technology recently issued the “Shenzhen Extreme Pioneer City Construction Action Plan”.

src: 其中提出，2023年底前，建成高速率、大容量、低时延的超级宽带网络，实现“双千兆、全光网、1毫秒、万物联”网络建设目标，打造国内第一、世界领先的极速先锋城市。

src: 《计划》提出，加快升级千兆光网。
raw: The “Plan” proposes to accelerate the upgrade of gigabit optical networks.

src: 2023年底前，10G PON端口占比达到100%，全光工业园区(产业园区)数量超过100家。

src: 《计划》要求，全面提升5G网络能效。
raw: The Plan requires a comprehensive improvement in the energy efficiency of 5G networks.

src: 研究制定深圳5G网络服务质量规范标准，开展5G网络测试评估，提升5G网络服务质量。
raw: Research and develop standards for the quality of service of Shenzhen’s 5G networks, conduct 5G network testing and evaluation, and improve the overall quality of 5G network services.

src: 支持基础电信企业加大对重点区域、场所5G网络的优化力度，全年新增5G基站10000个，全市平均下载速率达到500Mbps、上行速率达到100Mbps，重点区域下载速率达到1000Mbps、上行速率达到200Mbps，网络速率和用户体验感大幅提升。
raw: Supports basic telecommunications companies in enhancing the optimization of 5G networks in key areas and locations. An additional 10,000 5G base stations will be installed throughout the year, resulting in an average download speed of 500 Mbps and an upload speed of 100 Mbps across the city. In key areas, the download speed will reach 1000 Mbps, and the upload speed will reach 200 Mbps, significantly improving both network performance and user experience.

src: 打造城市级高品质无线局域网。
raw: Create high-quality wireless local area networks at the city level.

src: 制定公共场所无线局域网(WLAN)服务规范，推动全市各区人员密集和信息消费需求集中区域WLAN升级，提供千兆接入能力。
raw: Develop service specifications for wireless local area network (WLAN) in public places, promote the upgrade of WLAN systems in densely populated areas and regions with high information consumption demands across all districts of the city, and provide gigabit access capabilities.

src: 依托“深i网”建设全市公共无线局域网统一认证监管平台，实现“一次认证、无感漫游、智能切换”，支持运营主体将具有公共服务能力的社会自建AP(无线接入点)纳入认证监管平台。
raw: Relying on the “Shen-i Network,” a unified authentication and supervision platform for the city’s public wireless local area networks is established to achieve “one-time authentication, seamless roaming, and intelligent switching.” This platform also supports operators in incorporating self-built APs (wireless access points) from the community that provide public services into the authentication and supervision system.

src: 2023年底前，升级接入AP总量不少于2万个。
raw: By the end of 2023, the total number of upgraded and connected APs will be no less than 20,000.

src: 此外，《计划》还提出，建设高品质全光运力网络、构建多层次算力供给体系、加快关键通信网络设施建设、提升互联网应用服务能力。
raw: In addition, the 'Plan' also proposes to establish a high-quality all-optical capacity network, build a multi-level computing power supply system, accelerate the construction of key communication network facilities, and enhance the capabilities of internet application services.

src: 《计划》明确，协同构建物联感知体系。
raw: The “Plan” clearly states the need to collaboratively establish an IoT (Internet of Things) perception system.

src: 探索以“开源鸿蒙”操作系统为基础，构建城市感知终端建设管理模式，降低对接成本，加快建设城市级物联感知平台，推动市区物联网平台、各领域专业物联网平台网络与数据互联互通。
raw: Explore the establishment of a management model for urban perception terminals based on the “open-source HarmonyOS” operating system, reduce integration costs, accelerate the construction of city-level IoT (Internet of Things) perception platforms, and promote interconnection and data sharing between the urban IoT platforms and specialized IoT platforms in various fields.

src: 深化物联感知在城市管理、民生服务、公共安全、交通出行等领域应用，拓展城市道路、建筑、公共设施等固定感知与智能网联汽车等移动感知采集渠道。
raw: Deepen the application of IoT (Internet of Things) technologies in areas such as urban management, public services, public safety, and transportation. Expand the channels for data collection, including both fixed sensors located on urban roads, buildings, and public facilities, as well as mobile sensors from intelligent connected vehicles.

src: 2023年底前，水电气物联网感知终端数量超过900万，打造20个多功能智能杆应用示范项目。
raw: By the end of 2023, the number of IoT sensing terminals for water, electricity, and gas will exceed 9 million, with 20 demonstration projects for the application of multi-functional intelligent poles being established.

src: 《计划》还提到，加强卫星与地面通信融合应用、布局低空网络基础设施建设、推进海上5G网络深度覆盖。
raw: The Plan also mentions strengthening the integrated use of satellite and ground communication technologies, deploying the construction of low-altitude network infrastructure, and promoting the extensive coverage of 5G networks at sea.

src: 同时，推进海上5G网络深度覆盖、构建产业创新发展生态、支持举办顶级赛事和活动。
raw: At the same time, efforts are being made to promote the deep coverage of 5G networks at sea, build an ecosystem for innovative industrial development, and support the organization of top-tier events and activities.

src: “在这些数字背后，我们能感受到一个蓬勃生长、具有旺盛生命力的作者生态。

src: 北京师范大学传播创新与未来媒体实验平台此前发布了《电商行业内容生态健康指数(ECHI)报告》，从数据维度解析了当前电商行业中“新变量”——优质内容的重要性，运用指数对国内27家主流电商平台内容生态情况进行了评估。
raw: The Communication Innovation and Future Media Experimental Platform at Beijing Normal University previously released the “E-commerce Industry Content Ecology Health Index (ECHI) Report,” which analyzes the importance of high-quality content as a “new variable” in the current e-commerce sector from a data-driven perspective. The report uses this index to assess the content ecology of 27 major domestic e-commerce platforms.

src: 根据上述报告的电商行业内容生态健康指数排名，抖音电商、快手、淘宝、拼多多、京东位居前五。
raw: According to the rankings of the E-commerce Industry Content Ecology Health Index from the aforementioned report, Douyin E-commerce, Kuaishou, Taobao, Pinduoduo, and JD.com make up the top five.

src: 报告认为，电商行业内容生态是一个综合性概念，是将电商与内容进行整合，但并非所有内容都可与电商整合，好的PGC(专业生产内容)与UGC(用户原创内容)才是与电商进行整合的优质载体，内容平台价值越高，消费与推广的场景也就越来越丰富，电商植入的可能性也就越高，商业价值也就越强，这种公共领域和私人领域逐步集成分布的电商内容生产和内容消费的比例也就会越高。
raw: The report argues that the content ecosystem in the e-commerce industry is a comprehensive concept that integrates e-commerce with various types of content. However, not all types of content are suitable for integration with e-commerce. High-quality PGC (professionally produced content) and UGC (user-generated content) are the ideal mediums for this integration. The greater the value of the content platform, the more diverse the scenarios for consumption and promotion become, and the higher the potential for integrating e-commerce elements into these platforms. Consequently, the commercial value increases, leading to a higher proportion of e-commerce-related content production and consumption that spans both public and private domains.

src: 现场，北京师范大学新闻传播学院教授、中国传媒经济与管理专业委员会理事长喻国明对《报告》做了分析解读。
raw: At the event, Yu Guoming, a professor at the School of Journalism and Communication at Beijing Normal University and the chairman of the China Media Economics and Management Professional Committee, analyzed and interpreted the Report.

src: 他表示，就内容价值而言，当前电商行业已经从“消费可及性”过渡到“消费品质化”阶段，优质、专业、差异化的内容是电商行业的“硬通货”。
raw: He stated that, in terms of content value, the current e-commerce industry has moved from a focus on “consumption accessibility” to a stage of “consumption quality.” High-quality, professional, and differentiated content has become the “hard currency” of the e-commerce sector.

src: 同时，内容成为电商发展新阶段的根本和抓手，知识付费、专业性知识、KOL(关键意见领袖)等PGC内容开始在电商直播中成为标配。
raw: At the same time, content has become the foundation and key driver for the new stage of e-commerce development. Services such as knowledge-based payments, specialized knowledge, and PGC (Professional Generated Content) provided by KOLs (Key Opinion Leaders) have begun to become standard features in e-commerce live broadcasts.

src: 展望电商行业的未来发展，喻国明提出两方面的建议。
raw: Looking ahead to the future development of the e-commerce industry, Yu Guoming puts forward two suggestions.

src: 一个是从内容结构提升的角度看，推动电商内容生态健康程度和质量整体提升，打造正向内容创作和管理标准，实现电商行业内容生态健康系统指数与动态均衡。
raw: One approach is to enhance the overall health and quality of the e-commerce content ecosystem from the perspective of its structural organization. This involves establishing positive standards for content creation and management, thereby achieving a balanced and dynamic system index that reflects the health of the e-commerce industry's content ecosystem.

src: 另一个是从外部生态看，要实现内容电商行业的健康发展和外部环境的价值协同与共创。
raw: Another aspect is to consider the external ecosystem: it is necessary to achieve healthy development in the content e-commerce industry, as well as value synergy and co-creation with the surrounding environment.

src: “未来电商行业还需要更多的数据、人工智能方面的支持，形成对未来发展稳定性的预测；此外，为商家提供更规范、健康的成长空间，实现电商行业中企业、用户、产品与服务的价值协同，共创健康内容生态。
raw: “The future of the e-commerce industry will require more support in terms of data and artificial intelligence to predict the stability of its development. In addition, it is necessary to provide merchants with a more standardized and healthy environment for growth, enabling the coordination of values among companies, users, products, and services within the e-commerce sector, and thus jointly creating a healthy content ecosystem.”

src: 新加坡旅游业复苏强劲 入境旅客比2021年增长19倍
raw: Singapore’s tourism industry has made a strong recovery, with the number of inbound tourists increasing by 19 times compared to 2021.

src: （综合11日电）新加坡旅游局近日公布，预计2023年到访新加坡的国际旅客人次可达1200万至1400万，将带来约180亿至210亿新元的旅游收益；旅客人次和旅游收入将恢复到2019年新冠疫情前约67%至75%的水平；2024年旅游业实现全面复苏的可能性很大。
raw: (Combining reports from the 11th): The Singapore Tourism Board recently announced that it expects the number of international visitors to Singapore to reach between 12 and 14 million in 2023, generating tourism revenues of approximately S$18 to S$21 billion. The number of visitors and tourism revenue are expected to return to around 67% to 75% of the levels prior to the COVID-19 pandemic in 2019. There is a high likelihood that the tourism industry will fully recover in 2024.

src: 2022年新加坡旅游市场逐步重新启动和恢复。
raw: The tourism market in Singapore gradually restarted and recovered in 2022.

src: 新加坡旅游局最新发布的统计数据显示，2022年入境旅客从2021年的33.06万人次增长19倍，达到630万人次，超越旅游局早前预估的400万至600万人次，游客已经恢复至疫情前33%的水平。
raw: The latest statistics released by the Singapore Tourism Board show that the number of inbound visitors in 2022 increased by 19 times compared to 2021, rising from 330,600 to 6.3 million. This exceeds the board’s earlier estimate of 4 to 6 million visitors, and represents a recovery to 33% of the levels seen before the pandemic.

src: 2022年1月至9月，新加坡旅游收入共计89.6亿新元，预计2022年全年旅游收入可达138亿至143亿新元，比2021年的18.9亿新元增长6倍至7倍，已经恢复到2019年新冠疫情前约50%至52%的水平。
raw: From January to September 2022, Singapore’s tourism revenue totaled S$8.96 billion. It is estimated that the annual tourism revenue for 2022 will reach between S$13.8 billion and S$14.3 billion, which is 6 to 7 times higher than the S$1.89 billion in 2021. This represents a recovery to approximately 50% to 52% of the levels seen before the COVID-19 pandemic in 2019.

src: 新加坡政府多措并举，加速旅游业复苏。
raw: The Singapore government is taking multiple measures to accelerate the recovery of the tourism industry.

src: 2022年4月，政府宣布拨款近5亿新元用来刺激旅游业复苏。
raw: In April 2022, the government announced the allocation of nearly 500 million Singapore dollars to stimulate the recovery of the tourism industry.

src: 旅游局日前宣布，将计划在未来两年从这笔预算中拨出1.1亿新元，推出更多商业和休闲活动吸引旅客回流。
raw: The Tourism Authority recently announced that it plans to allocate S$110 million from this budget over the next two years to launch more business and leisure activities aimed at attracting tourists back.

src: 为了使健康养生成为新加坡的旅游亮点之一，新加坡旅游局在2022年11月23日发布了一份意向征集活动，计划在新加坡南部海岸开发一个健康养生景点。
raw: In order to make wellness tourism one of the highlights of Singapore's tourist offerings, the Singapore Tourism Board launched a public consultation campaign on November 23, 2022, with the aim of developing a wellness destination along the southern coast of Singapore.

src: 新加坡旅游局体育与康养旅游执行署长王凌丽说，近年来，越来越多的游客把身体健康放在各项考虑因素的首位。
raw: Wang Lingli, the Head of the Sports and Wellness Tourism Division at the Singapore Tourism Board, said that in recent years, an increasing number of tourists have placed their physical health at the top of their list of considerations when making travel decisions.

src: 在拥有滨海湾花园、滨海堤坝的滨海南区开发一个健康养生景点，有望为新加坡的旅游业和经济作出贡献，让游客在新加坡消费并逗留更久。
raw: Developing a health and wellness attraction in the southern area of Binhai, which includes the Binhai Bay Gardens and the Binhai Causeway, is expected to contribute to Singapore's tourism industry and economy. This will encourage tourists to spend more money in Singapore and stay for a longer period of time.

src: 新加坡旅游局局长陈建隆表示，未来几年内，健康养生将成为新加坡旅游产品的重要组成部分。
raw: Chen Jianlong, the Director of Tourism at Singapore, stated that in the coming years, health and wellness will become an important part of Singapore's tourism offerings.

src: 新冠疫情提升了公众对于身体和心理健康的认知和需求。
raw: The COVID-19 pandemic has raised public awareness and demand for both physical and mental health.

src: 为此，过去两年旅游局一直向本地公众和国际游客推广健康养生项目。
raw: For this reason, over the past two years, the Tourism Authority has been promoting health and wellness programs to both the local public and international tourists.

src: 2022年6月，新加坡旅游局举办了首届健康养生节，为公众提供了130多项各类健康活动和体验。
raw: In June 2022, the Singapore Tourism Board organized the first Health and Wellness Festival, offering the public more than 130 various health-related activities and experiences.

src: 新加坡将持续为游客提供新的旅行体验。
raw: Singapore will continue to offer visitors new and exciting travel experiences.

src: 除新开放的新加坡儿童博物馆、滨海湾花园的阿凡达世界、圣淘沙中央海滩市集、艺术科学博物馆新增的“探索新领域”展厅，以及夜间野生动物园新建的露天剧场外，旅游局将支持万态野生动物世界的飞禽公园等项目发展与更新，使新加坡成为具有吸引力的国际旅行地。
raw: In addition to the newly opened Singapore Children’s Museum, Avatar World at Marina Bay Gardens, the Central Beach Market in Sentosa, the “Exploring New Frontiers” exhibition hall at the Arts and Sciences Museum, and the newly built outdoor theater at the Night Wildlife Park, the Tourism Board will support the development and renewal of attractions such as the Bird Park at Wild Wild Life. This will help make Singapore an attractive international travel destination.

src: 按照计划，新加坡将于2023年年内制定会议、会展与奖励旅游业可持续发展的相关行业标准，并着重改善废物处理和碳排放两大方面的问题，进一步优化旅游环境。
raw: According to the plan, Singapore will establish industry standards for the sustainable development of the conference, exhibition, and rewards tourism sector by the end of 2023. The focus will be on improving waste management and carbon emissions, with the aim of further enhancing the tourism environment.

src: 新加坡旅游业的复苏加快了航空业复苏。
raw: The recovery of Singapore's tourism industry has accelerated the recovery of the aviation sector as well.

src: 数据显示，截至2022年12月18日，樟宜机场客流量强劲复苏，每天接待的乘客已多达15万人次，每周约100万人次，相当于新冠疫情前的75%左右，航空业员工在岗数量也已经恢复到疫情前约90%的水平。
raw: Data shows that as of December 18, 2022, passenger traffic at Changi Airport has strongly recovered, with up to 150,000 passengers being handled daily and approximately 1 million passengers per week. This represents around 75% of the levels prior to the COVID-19 pandemic. The number of aviation industry employees also has returned to about 90% of its pre-pandemic levels.

src: 数据显示，2022年1月至10月新加坡已接待旅客2360万人次，相当于新冠疫情前的42%，起降航班17万架次，是疫情前的53%。
raw: Data shows that from January to October 2022, Singapore welcomed 23.6 million visitors, which is 42% of the level before the COVID-19 pandemic. Additionally, there were 170,000 flight departures and arrivals, representing 53% of the number of flights during the pre-pandemic period.

src: 旅游业快速复苏，也带动了住宿、交通、餐饮和购物等行业的复苏步伐。
raw: The tourism industry has recovered rapidly, which in turn has accelerated the recovery of related sectors such as accommodation, transportation, dining, and shopping.

src: 新加坡政府和旅游业对中国市场寄予厚望。
raw: The Singaporean government and the tourism industry have high hopes for the Chinese market.

src: 新加坡旅游局国际司助理局长柯淑丹说，中国旅行平台的一项调查显示，新加坡的安全指数位列全球前三，这也是新加坡深受中国游客喜爱的原因之一。
raw: Koh Shu Dan, Assistant Director of the International Department at the Singapore Tourism Board, said that a survey by a Chinese travel platform ranked Singapore’s safety index among the top three in the world, which is one of the reasons why Singapore is so popular among Chinese tourists.

src: 新冠疫情前，中国每年有约360万人次到新加坡旅行度假。
raw: Before the COVID-19 pandemic, approximately 3.6 million people from China traveled to Singapore for vacations each year.

src: 随着中国放宽边境政策，预计今年中国游客人次可恢复至2019年的三成至六成。
raw: As China relaxes its border policies, it is expected that the number of Chinese tourists this year could recover to 30% to 60% of the level in 2019.

src: 柯淑丹指出，接下来，旅游局将密切关注中国针对出境旅行政策进一步释放的信号，以应对游客需求的变化。
raw: Ke Shudan stated that in the future, the Tourism Bureau will closely monitor any further signals from China regarding policies related to outbound travel, in order to respond to the changing needs of tourists.

src: 新加坡旅游局除与携程等中国线上旅行平台、旅行社强化伙伴关系外，将针对中国境外游出现的新趋势，积极做好接待中国游客的准备。
raw: In addition to strengthening partnerships with Chinese online travel platforms such as Ctrip and travel agencies, the Singapore Tourism Board will actively prepare to welcome Chinese tourists in response to the new trends in travel outside of China.

src: 展望2023年旅游市场，新加坡旅游局充满信心，认为全球经济只要不出现显著衰退影响公众收入，以及不再有新的大面积致命疫情暴发等情况出现，旅游业复苏步伐将快于预期。
raw: Looking ahead to the tourism market in 2023, the Singapore Tourism Board is confident that the recovery of the tourism industry will be faster than expected, provided that there is no significant global economic recession that affects public incomes, and no new large-scale and deadly pandemics occur.

raw: The battery doesn’t charge fully.

src: 机器确实不错，想问下怎么第一次充电起就充不满啊，充电指示灯一直红色
raw: The machine is indeed quite good. I just want to ask why it doesn’t get fully charged on the first charge attempt; the charging indicator light remains red the whole time.

src: 非常完美的一次购物！
raw: A perfectly wonderful shopping experience!

src: 非常满意，非常喜欢，亚马逊海外购都是正品毋庸置疑，质量也非常好，物美价廉，买的放心，售后服务很周到，客服态度都很亲切和蔼，处理问题耐心高效，完美解决后顾之忧，配套的快递送货上门非常便捷稳妥，送货师傅很替顾客着想，每次都会提醒及时从快递柜中取货，感谢亚马逊给顾客提供如此舒适的购物体验。
raw: Very satisfied and delighted! There’s no doubt that all products purchased from Amazon’s international sales are genuine; the quality is excellent as well. The products offer great value for money, making purchases a reliable option. The after-sales service is outstanding, with customer representatives being friendly and accommodating. They handle issues patiently and efficiently, perfectly addressing any concerns customers may have. The delivery service is also convenient and reliable; the delivery staff consider the needs of customers, always reminding them to pick up their parcels from the designated collection points in a timely manner. I’m grateful to Amazon for providing such a comfortable shopping experience.

src: 总之，我们全家都喜欢在亚马逊海外购shopping!
raw: In short, our whole family loves shopping overseas on Amazon!

src: 严重货不对板。

src: 是要来逗比的么？！
raw: Are you here to make jokes?!

src: 完全遮不到阳光。

src: 尺码 物流
raw: Size, Logistics

src: 做工还可以，就是物流太慢了，以前的鞋子什么都是DHL，这次Apex真是...国内买过很多UA，价格都不低，感觉搞的比NIKE ADIDAS档次高？
raw: The quality of the products is okay, but the logistics are really slow. In the past, all our shoes were shipped via DHL. This time with Apex… We bought quite a few UA products domestically, and the prices weren’t low at all. It feels like UA has a higher status or quality compared to Nike and Adidas, right?

src: 其实都一样好吧，所以海淘。
raw: Actually, it’s all the same anyway, so let’s just do online shopping from abroad.

src: 尺码：我身高176CM，68KG，我肩膀宽一般衣服都是180的，买的M，下摆略微长，其它穿了正好，我看有推荐S码的，身材那么纤细吗？还是喜欢紧身？我觉得帽衫还是宽松些好。
raw: Size: I am 176 cm tall and weigh 68 kg. My shoulders are of average width, so I usually wear size 180 for clothes. The garment I bought is size M; the hem is a bit long, but otherwise it fits perfectly. I saw some recommendations for size S – does that mean the person’s figure is really that slim? Or do people prefer clothes that fit more tightly? I think hoodies should be a bit looser in fit.

src: 之所以给3星，是因为这个是和人生的初恋买的，交往了快3年，就这样于去年离我而去了，一直到现在。
raw: The reason for giving 3 stars is that this item was purchased as a souvenir of my first love in life. We dated for almost 3 years, but then she left me last year, and that’s still the case to this day.

src: 之所以给3星，是因为这个是和人生的初恋买的，现在不知道用到什么程度了，或许扔掉了吧！
raw: The reason for giving 3 stars is that this item was purchased along with the first love of my life. I don’t know how much it’s still being used nowadays; maybe it’s already been thrown away!

src: 交往了快3年，就这样于去年离我而去了，到现在一想起她，就心痛的想要离开这个世界，人生中第一个女人，带给我一辈子的阴影和心痛，迄今还没能走出来。
raw: We had been together for almost three years when she left me last year. Even now, whenever I think of her, it feels so painful that I want to leave this world. She was the first woman in my life, and she brought me shadows and heartache that have lasted a lifetime; to this day, I still haven’t been able to overcome it.

src: 买这个手机的时候，想想两个当时感觉，还是能一起同甘共苦，但现在却是不堪回首，人生或许就是这样吧，有些人一辈子都不想遇到，有些事儿一辈子都不想知道，可是有什么办法呢？
raw: When I bought this phone, I thought about the two feelings I had at that time: the desire to share both the good times and the bad times together. But now, those moments are simply unbearable to recall. Perhaps life is just like that—there are some people we never want to meet in our lives, and there are some things we never want to know. But what can we do about it?

src: 多少次一看到三星这个手机，脑海就想起她，那种痛苦就随之而来灌满全身，我从没舍得用过超过2千元的手机，可是买给她的时候，却毫不犹豫，对一个人再好，可是有天当她变心了，所有的山盟海誓也就烟消云散了。
raw: How many times has it happened that whenever I see a Samsung phone, her image comes to mind immediately, and a sense of pain overcomes me? I’ve never been willing to spend more than 2,000 yuan on a phone for myself. However, when I bought one for her, I didn’t hesitate for a second. No matter how good you are to someone, one day, if they change their heart, all the promises and vows vanish like smoke.

src: 提货服务有待改进
raw: The delivery service needs to be improved.

src: 我一共买了5份提货券，在提取时，第一次预约提取3份，结果只寄过来2份，经过多方沟通才确认是漏发、答应后需补发；第二次预约，刚好赶上休息日，网站和微信均无提示需要在工作日预约，造成了不必要的恐慌，建议以后改善。
raw: I purchased a total of 5 delivery vouchers. When I went to collect them, I scheduled the collection for 3 vouchers the first time, but only 2 were sent. After much communication, it was confirmed that the remaining vouchers had been accidentally missed and they promised to send them out again. The second time I scheduled the collection, it happened to be a weekend, and neither the website nor WeChat gave any notice indicating that collections needed to be scheduled on weekdays, which caused unnecessary panic. It is recommended that this issue be improved in the future.

src: 质量没的说，若论写字，不如925-25
raw: The quality is beyond doubt; when it comes to handwriting, however, it’s not as good as 925-25.

src: 先赞一下天天快递吧，航空件，超迅速，服务态度也很好！
raw: Let’s start by giving a thumbs up to TianTian Express. Their air deliveries are extremely fast, and the customer service is also very good!

src: 一直在用925-25,非常棒，刚收到925-85，笔的质量没的说，样式也非常漂亮，之所以给四星是因为笔有点重，不适合快速写字，笔帽调节铅芯长度处有点晃动，个人意见：925-25要比85更顺手。
raw: I’ve been using the 925-25 model, and it’s absolutely great. I just received the 925-85 model as well. The quality of the pen is outstanding, and the design is very beautiful too. The reason I gave it four stars is that the pen is a bit heavy, which makes it unsuitable for fast writing. Additionally, the part of the pen cap that adjusts the length of the lead shaft seems a bit shaky. In my opinion, the 925-25 model is more comfortable to use than the 925-85 model.

src: 价格实惠，日原产，有中文标签，带颗粒，绝对回购！
raw: Affordable price, made in Japan, comes with a Chinese label, and contains granules – I would definitely buy it again!

src: 膏体里带颗粒的，清爽感恰到好处，用后牙齿爽滑，上比某二手东强太多啦，那里说是进口的东西，可好多东西没有中文标签，不知从哪里批发的。
raw: The paste contains particles, and it has a perfectly refreshing texture. After using it, my teeth feel smooth and clean. It’s much better than that second-hand product I bought; although they claimed it was imported, many of the items don’t have any Chinese labels, so I don’t know where it was wholesaled from.

src: 以后只要亚马逊有的，绝不再去二手东。
raw: In the future, as long as something is available on Amazon, I will never buy it from second-hand sellers again.

src: 给个建议，亚马逊的app 上晒单怎么有时晒不了，希望能改进一些应用，会做的越来越好的！
raw: Here’s a suggestion: Why can’t some orders be displayed on the Amazon app sometimes? I hope they can improve the app; it’s getting better and better with each update!

src: 效果还行
raw: The effect is okay.

src: 猫猫喜欢吃，这是重点。
raw: The cat really likes to eat it – that’s the main point.

src: 也确实有效果。
raw: And it does work effectively as well.

src: 垃圾
raw: Garbage

src: 看到这样的包裹，试问大家:觉不觉得是路边的垃圾?
raw: Seeing such a package, I ask everyone: don’t you think it looks like trash that just got thrown on the side of the road?

src: 一个塑料易碎的包装，就用一个塑料袋从所谓的德国发过来，这样的包装是负责的吗?
raw: A plastic, fragile package – which was simply sent from Germany using a regular plastic bag. Is such packaging really appropriate for such products?

src: 我看这样的包装是装垃圾一样的，购买这个产品，包装及其简陋，没有任何防止破损的措施，就一个简单的塑料袋包装，到手后，包裹完全变形了，里面的物品也有破损。
raw: I think such packaging is suitable for trash only. The product itself is purchased in a very basic, poorly designed package that provides no protection against damage at all; it’s just a simple plastic bag. Upon receipt, the package is completely deformed, and the items inside are also damaged.

src: 如果我只是碰到一个这样的，我认了，买了几个都是这样子，找亚马逊客服，客服就说可以退，但运费垫付，然后运费以礼品卡的形式返回给我。
raw: If I had just encountered one of these products, I would have accepted it. I bought several products, and all of them were in the same condition. I contacted Amazon customer service, who said that I could return the products, but the shipping cost would have to be prepaid. The shipping cost was then refunded to me in the form of a gift card.

src: 我试问一下，我用现金支付运费，你们给我返礼品卡，这是要我自己买你们礼品卡就直说啊，还要自己把产品邮寄到德国仓库，这不是买个产品受罪啊!
raw: I’d like to ask: I pay for the shipping costs in cash, and you offer me a gift card as a refund. But if you want me to buy the gift card myself, just say so clearly. Moreover, I have to mail the product to the warehouse in Germany myself. Isn’t that just creating extra trouble for me simply because I want to purchase a product?

src: 而我一直跟客服说，出现这样的问题是谁的责任，客服却半句不说是他们的责任，连半句责任都不敢担当，这样的售后服务还有什么保障呢? 一句话:认栽!但我估计我这个评价，亚马逊都不会给公布的机会，直接回删除!
raw: And I’ve been telling the customer service all along who is responsible for such problems, but they refuse to admit even a single word that it’s their fault—they don’t even dare to take any responsibility. What kind of after-sales service is this, then? In one word: they should just admit their mistake! But I guess Amazon won’t even give my review a chance to be published; they’ll just delete it directly.

src: 此款AV功放机设置复杂，外表做工粗糙，发热量大。
raw: This AV amplifier has a complex setup, rough manufacturing quality, and generates a significant amount of heat.

src: 声音要用过一段时间再评！
raw: The sound needs to be used for a while before I can give a review!

src: 8月14日刚入手德版的DN1080.一看外做工好差。
raw: I just bought the German version of the DN1080 on August 14th. At first glance, the quality of the exterior workmanship is extremely poor.

src: 1.前面板，旋钮都塑料的。
raw: 1. The front panel and all the knobs are made of plastic.

src: 2.后板音频输入插口，喇叭输出端子都好差，随便找台1000-2000的CD功放一体机要比这款好太多了。
raw: 2. The audio input jack on the rear panel, as well as the speaker output terminals, are of very poor quality. Any CD/DVD player combo that costs between 1000 and 2000 yuan would be much better than this product.

src: 3.顶盖比较薄，我的变压器那边还凹下去了，不得已开箱用手恢复，顶盖和前面板结合松动。
raw: 3. The top cover is quite thin; the area around my transformer has even become dented. I had no choice but to open the box and manually repair it. The connection between the top cover and the front panel is loose.

src: 4.整个机器重心偏向变压器端，搬动的时候很别扭。
raw: 4. The center of gravity of the entire machine is biased towards the transformer side, making it very awkward to move.

src: 感觉是SONY入门款机器，就那做工，马来西亚出品的。
raw: It feels like a basic entry-level model from SONY, just looking at the quality of construction; it’s produced in Malaysia.

src: 感觉索尼要放在中国代工要比小马好多了。
raw: It seems that it would be much better for Sony to have manufacturing in China done by local contractors rather than by companies like Xiaomi.

src: 5.机器发热大，看场电影用的两声道2个小时左右顶盖用手摸一下得有40-50℃，不知道是不是变压器太大发热量大。
raw: 5. The machine generates a lot of heat. When using it to watch a movie in 2-channel mode for about 2 hours, the temperature of the top cover reaches 40–50°C when touched by hand. I’m not sure if this is because the transformer is too large and therefore produces more heat.

src: 现在多用开关电源，这个傻大的变压器估计得有4KG。
raw: These days, switch-mode power supplies are more commonly used; that huge transformer must weigh about 4 kilograms.

src: 索尼应该在机器里面用主动散热的静音风扇，开箱后只看到管子上大型铝板散热片。
raw: Sony should use passive cooling fans with silent operation inside the devices. Upon opening the box, all that was visible were large aluminum heat sinks attached to the pipes.

src: 感觉不太好
raw: It doesn’t feel very good…

src: 首先是箱子并不怎么结实，用加按一下就变形了，其次是背面设计的平放时防止箱面的ABS刮花并起不了作用，再次是箱子里面就是一块布包着、拉杆的地方凸显出来..等等，各种不满意，最后拉链有点不顺畅。
raw: First of all, the box isn’t very sturdy; it bends with just a little pressure. Secondly, the design on the back is intended to prevent the ABS material on the box’s surface from scratching when the box is placed flat, but it doesn’t really work effectively. Furthermore, the inside of the box is just covered with a piece of fabric, and the area where the handles are located is clearly visible… There are all sorts of issues with this product. Finally, the zipper operates a bit smoothly.

src: PS：轮子感觉确实挺好的
raw: PS: The wheels really feel quite good.

src: 总体不错，有点小问题
raw: Overall it’s good, but there are a few minor issues.

src: 第一次购买滤水壶，看了几篇评价文章，感觉LAICA的性价比高些就选择了这个，收到货按说明书装好了滤芯，试用了一下，感觉总体不错，但是在倒水的时候好像原水会从壶嘴的地方与处理后的水混合（原水仓密封不太严）。
raw: This is my first purchase of a water filter pitcher. After reading several review articles, I decided on the LAICA model due to its good cost-performance ratio. Upon receiving the product, I installed the filter cartridge according to the instructions and gave it a try. Overall, it seems to work well. However, when pouring water, it appears that the raw water mixes with the filtered water at the spout of the pitcher (the seal of the raw water storage compartment is not very tight).

src: 用的时候一定要等所有水过滤完再倒出！
raw: Be sure to wait until all the water has been filtered out before pouring it!

src: 好看，但有点点小遗憾
raw: It looks nice, but there’s a slight regret…

src: 整个杯子的颜色是我狠喜欢的，橘红色，虽然我家是男宝，但是还是觉得橘红配黄色很亮眼。
raw: The color of the entire cup is something I really love—orange-red. Although I have a baby boy, I still think that orange-red combined with yellow looks very striking.

src: 比我想象的小一些，不过本来就是拿来带出门用的，所以还可以接受。
raw: It’s a bit smaller than I expected, but since it’s meant to be used outdoors anyway, it’s still acceptable.

src: 昨晚拿回家试了一下，瓶盖推开之后，吸管和盖子之间的距离太近了，因为吸管的位置是正向垂直的，所以儿子总是要把盖子上面的凸起含住喝水，觉得这个地方是否可以改进一下。
raw: I took it home last night to give it a try. After opening the bottle cap, the distance between the straw and the cap was too short. Since the straw is positioned vertically in the correct direction, my son always has to hold the protrusion on the cap with his mouth while drinking water. I wonder if this aspect could be improved somehow.

src: 看来其他牌子的吸管杯把吸管做的倾斜还是有道理的，小孩子的东西，真的就是在乎安全和舒适。
raw: It seems that there’s a reason why straws in cup holders from other brands are designed to be at an angle; after all, these products are for children, and safety and comfort really matter.

src: 还行，作为新手来说，值得入手
raw: It’s okay; for a beginner, it’s worth buying.

src: 品相过得去，和极品金刚没得比，之前看过商场那个价格，少说都好几百，我是第一次玩金刚，还行。
raw: The quality is okay, but it can’t compare to the top-of-the-line versions of the “King Kong” products. I saw the prices in the mall before, and they were at least several hundred dollars lower. This is my first time playing the “King Kong” game, so it’s still quite decent.

src: 产品防伪标识在哪里
raw: Where are the product anti-counterfeiting markings located?

src: 瓶子底部一角凹陷的厉害，应该是经历过强烈的撞击才能导致的，从外包装袋看，感觉蹂躏的程度让人揪心，毕竟是食物类的包装太简单了，而且还是属于国际购的，还有没看到什么明显的防伪标识标志，开瓶非常轻松，关键是盖内的一层蜂蜜直接从里面冒出来了，有开口几乎是没有什么粘连性，外国产品都是这样的吗？
raw: The corner at the bottom of the bottle is severely dented; this must have been caused by a powerful impact. Judging from the outer packaging bag, the extent of damage is truly concerning. After all, the packaging for food products is usually very simple, especially when the products are imported from abroad. There don’t seem to be any obvious anti-counterfeiting features either. The bottle was extremely easy to open, and the layer of honey inside the cap actually came out directly. With such an opening, there’s almost no residue or sticking at all. Is this the case with all foreign products?

src: 生在中国的我有点不理解了。
raw: As someone born in China, I kind of don’t understand this.

src: 应该是正品吧？
raw: It should be the genuine product, right?

src: 还有拍下时提示二十几号到，这个是14号收到的，我第一次在这里海外购，只是把自己的疑惑写下来，或许这都是正常的？
raw: It also mentioned in the notification that the item would arrive around the 20th of some month; however, I received it on the 14th. This is my first time making a purchase overseas from this source. I’m just writing down my doubts – perhaps all of this is normal?

src: 高二的时候看的这本书当时只是抱着无聊看看玩的心态，感觉这样的书自己应该不会沉迷吧，毕竟起点的网文以往还是不太吸引我的。
raw: I read this book in my second year of high school, just out of boredom. I thought I wouldn’t get too engrossed in it, considering that online novels in general haven’t really attracted me much in the past.

src: 然后...就掉坑里了。
raw: And then… I fell into a pit.

src: 按着这个剧情来说，整本书都是比较轻松愉快的，前部分叶修还在网游里的时候，即使是公会之间勾心斗角，也因为往往被叶神狗血，搞得一点也不沉重。
raw: According to this plot, the whole book is quite light and enjoyable. In the earlier parts, when Ye Xiu is still playing in the online game, even the scheming and power struggles between guilds don’t become too serious because Ye Xiu’s antics always make things seem comical or absurd.

src: 至于到了比赛的部分，写出了时代的变迁新旧交替的一点点心酸之感（可能是我多愁善感）。
raw: As for the part about the actual competition, I expressed a slight sense of sadness regarding the changes of the times and the transition from the old to the new (maybe I’m just being too sentimental).

src: 看整部书花了我高二许多学习时间，可是就是停不下来。
raw: It took me a lot of study time during my second year of high school to read the entire book, but I just couldn’t stop.

src: 全职对人物和感情线的描写让人十分惊艳，有的人物只是偶尔带过，也会给人留下很深的影响，像比较重点描写的角色叶修黄少天苏沐橙都有大量的粉丝，而不在写作中心的角色例如江波涛楚云秀等等也十分找人喜欢，在一个电竞的爽文中竟然让人找不到一个让人讨厌至极的人物，这是全职在人物描写上的成功。
raw: The in-depth portrayal of characters and their emotional relationships in “Full-time” is truly remarkable. Even characters that are only briefly mentioned have a profound impact on the story. Key characters like Ye Xiu, Huang Shaotian, and Su Mucheng have a huge number of fans, while those who are not at the center of the narrative, such as Jiang Botao and Chu Yunxiu, are also very likable. It’s astonishing that, within a story set in the world of esports, there isn’t a single character who is truly detestable. This is a testament to the success of “Full-time” in terms of character development.

src: 而在感情线上，全职也没有一般网文所令人诟病的后宫佳丽三千万要么美女要么腐的毛病，全文所有人的感情，都有一个共同的地方就是他们喜欢着荣耀这个游戏，并且大都想要堂堂正正的胜利。
raw: On the emotional front, being a full-time player doesn’t incur the problems associated with the typical online novels, such as having an enormous harem of thirty million women—either all beautiful or of a perverted nature. src: 根据马斯洛需求层次理论，在人的基本生存需要得到满足后，最迫切的就是心理需要的满足——希望被理解、被肯定、被赏识。

raw: The author describes five types of expressive languages of appreciation in this book: affirmative words, thoughtful gestures, acts of service, pleasing gifts, and physical contact.

src: 我觉得重要的不是你知道赞赏的五种语言到底是什么，而是你能随时随地发自内心地用这五种语言去赞赏，去感恩身边的人，不管是家人，朋友还是同事。

src: 其实越是亲密的人越需要赞赏和感恩，这样我们的生活才会变得更加美好。

raw: Each short story is a snapshot of a brief moment from ordinary life, with no beginning and no ending.

src: 最后收集在一起，冠名《当我们谈论爱情时我们在谈论什么》。
raw: Finally, all these elements were gathered together and given the title “What Are We Talking About When We Talk About Love?”

src: 我想，这个小说集，以及它的标题，像是一种行为艺术，作者想表达的是，爱情不止是舞台上的悲欢离合，都市传说中的海枯石烂，也不只是你侬我侬的如胶似漆，爱情不止是以上也不应该被以上代表，爱情也是平淡如水的生活，枯燥无味的日复一日，也有对生活的无措，现实的逃避，未来的茫然。
raw: I think that this collection of novels, along with its title, serves as a form of performance art. The author wants to convey the idea that love is not merely about the highs and lows that occur on stage, or the enduring devotion depicted in urban legends; it’s also not just about the intense affection between two people. Love encompasses more than that, and should not be represented by those aspects alone. Love includes the mundane, everyday aspects of life, the tedious repetition of days, as well as feelings of helplessness in the face of life, the avoidance of reality, and the uncertainty about the future.

src: 阅读这本书时你脑海里可能回想起你身旁吵架的夫妻，认识的人的索然无味的婚姻，以及不如意的感情。
raw: As you read this book, memories of couples arguing around you, the dull and uninteresting marriages of people you know, and unsatisfactory relationships may come to mind.

src: 这正是我不推荐阅读的原因，从审美的角度上讲，本书的文笔和情节都索然无味，除非你的生活惊涛骇浪或者甜蜜得如生活在糖果城堡，否则你得阅读时的感觉就是见怪不怪和无聊。
raw: This is exactly why I don’t recommend reading it. From an aesthetic point of view, both the writing style and the plot are utterly dull. Unless your life is full of extreme highs and lows or as sweet as living in a candy castle, you’ll likely find the experience both predictable and boring.

src: 而从思想深度上，日常情节并没有让人眼前一亮或者扩展一个人的思路和视野（这点不同于马尔克斯的《霍乱时期的爱情》），短暂的片段也没有探讨任何问题，比如是什么样的错误导致了爱情的失败？
