src: 可以装A4幅面的文件，装过80页厚的，但太厚太硬的盒状物体（不能变形的）估计装不下。
raw: It can accommodate A4-sized documents; I’ve already used it to hold boxes that are 80 pages thick. However, objects that are too thick, too hard, and do not bend (i.e., cannot be deformed) probably won’t fit inside.

src: 包很软，里面内袋分隔也比较人性化，还是相当不错的。
raw: The package is very soft, and the inner compartments are well-designed for organization, making it quite a nice product.

src: 只是我拿到的这个底部有个小砂眼，不知道是我人品不好还是？
raw: It’s just that the one I got has a small sand hole on the bottom. I don’t know if it’s because of my bad luck or what…

src: 懒得折腾来回换货，忍了。
raw: Too lazy to go through the hassle of returning the product and getting a new one; I’ll just tolerate it.

src: 整体打个四星，还是值的。
raw: I give it a four-star rating overall; it’s still worth it.

src: 更适合年轻人
raw: More suitable for younger people

src: 99秒杀的。
raw: 99 products were sold out in just 1 second.

src: 毛裤的做工、颜色、手感都不错，柔软/薄厚适中，没有煤油味儿。
raw: The quality of construction, color, and feel of the woolen pants are all good; they are soft and have a moderate thickness, and there is no kerosene-like smell.

src: 遗憾的是版型属于瘦型的，更适合年轻人。
raw: Unfortunately, the design is more slim-fit and better suited for younger people.

src: 3XL，平铺腰围2尺5，拉伸最大尺寸4尺，1.79/80公斤穿着腰有点紧。
raw: Size 3XL: When laid flat, the waist measurement is 2 feet 5 inches; the maximum stretch size is 4 feet. Wearing this size for a person weighing 1.79/80 kilograms (about 3.97 kg) results in a slightly tight fit at the waist.

src: 似乎腰间没有松紧带，想加松点腰围还挺困难。
raw: It seems there’s no elastic band around the waist, so it’s quite difficult to make the waistband a bit looser.

src: 另外，贴身穿是不舒服的。
raw: Also, it’s uncomfortable to wear close to the skin.

src: 强烈建议亚马逊停用EMS ！
raw: I strongly recommend that Amazon discontinue the use of EMS!

src: 商品五星，物流一星，平均三星。
raw: Product: 5 stars; Logistics: 1 star; Average rating: 3 stars.

src: 不懂为什么亚马逊要寄EMS，业内公认的不靠谱，好嘛，电脑好歹也是贵重物品啊！
raw: I don’t understand why Amazon would use EMS for shipping; it’s widely recognized in the industry as an unreliable method. After all, a computer is a valuable item!

src: 买后订单显示，预计20号送达，于是家里人在家等了三天！
raw: After making the purchase, the order showed that delivery was expected on the 20th. So, our family members waited at home for three days!

src: 从厦门寄到福州，为什么要四五天啊！
raw: Why does it take four to five days to send something from Xiamen to Fuzhou?

src: 22号早上查物流终于到福州了，准备开开心心收货，结果，晚上在没收到任何电话、短信的情况下，一查物流，竟然中午就被签收了，还显示的本人签收！
raw: This morning on the 22nd, I checked the logistics tracking and finally saw that the package had arrived in Fuzhou. I was ready to happily receive it, but in the evening—without receiving any phone calls or texts—I checked the tracking again and found that the package had already been signed for at noon, and it even showed that I had signed for it myself!

src: 我瞬间震惊了！
raw: I was shocked in an instant!

src: 我是谁？我在哪儿？这电脑真是我买的吗？
raw: Who am I? Where am I? Did I really buy this computer?

src: 简直怀疑人生了好么！
raw: I’m just starting to doubt the whole meaning of life, you know?

src: 最后跑了一趟代收点才把电脑搬回来。
raw: I had to make one last trip to a collection point before I could get the computer back.

src: 具体原因简单说就是因为快递小哥把两个单号弄反了，好在件没丢也就算了。
raw: The specific reason, in simple terms, is that the delivery driver mixed up the two order numbers. Fortunately, the items weren’t lost, so that’s the main thing.

src: 我强烈建议亚马逊不要用EMS了，以后亚马逊如果用EMS寄的快递，我一定不会再买了。
raw: I strongly recommend that Amazon stop using EMS for deliveries. If Amazon continues to use EMS for shipping packages in the future, I will definitely not buy anything from them again.

src: 等待供货商回复
raw: Waiting for a response from the supplier.

src: 包装没有任何标识，直接给供货商致电说，回答没标识是正品，如怀疑可用边角料邮寄到强生公司验货，还留下车牌号以及电话号码，承诺会发短信通知把我的信息输入强生官网保修卡，到现在也没收到短信啊？
raw: The packaging had no markings at all. I directly called the supplier and was told that the absence of markings indicated that the product was genuine. If I had any doubts, I could send the product (including any spare parts) to Johnson & Johnson for inspection by mail. I also provided my vehicle license plate number and phone number, and they promised to send me a text message to inform me that they had entered my information into Johnson & Johnson’s official warranty database. However, I still haven’t received that text message to this day…

src: 日本亚马逊因为客服问题导致买家的利益严重受损（8c的毛毛虫发货为8cm的毛毛虫）（8c=14cm，8cm=2c）
raw: Japanese Amazon has severely damaged the interests of buyers due to customer service issues (8c caterpillars were shipped as 8cm caterpillars) (8c = 14cm, 8cm = 2c)

src: 承认错误，但是一直在推诿，始终强调货物为第三方，不能约束第三方。
raw: Admitting the mistake, but constantly shirking responsibility by emphasizing that the goods belong to a third party and that one cannot impose any obligations on that third party.

src: 我当初购买的页面尺码选项为7c，8，9c，当时觉得这就是个陷阱，打电话给日亚中文客服，明确告知8就是8c，但是等商品回到中国才发现，只有8cm，我觉得这完全是故意设下的陷阱来坑中国人（按照亚马逊的售后），现在查看页面已没有这个选项。
raw: The size options of the tape measure I purchased were 7c, 8, and 9c. I immediately felt that this was a trick. I called the Japanese customer service in Chinese and was clearly informed that “8” referred to 8c. However, when the product arrived in China, I found that the actual length was only 8 cm. I believe this was a deliberate attempt to deceive Chinese customers (according to Amazon’s after-sales policy). Now, when I check the product page, these size options are no longer available.

src: 中方客服：很抱歉，给你带来损失了，我们给你两条路走：
raw: Chinese Customer Service: We apologize for the inconvenience caused to you. We have two options for you:

src: 1，你退货，买家承担所有运费。
raw: 1. If you return the product, the buyer is responsible for all shipping costs.

src: 2，你不退货，我们补偿你1000日元。
raw: 2. If you don’t return the product, we will compensate you with 1000 yen.

src: （我算一下账，鞋子4000多日元，算作200rmb，选择1，我没有鞋子，损失在200元。
raw: (I do the math: the shoes cost over 4,000 yen, which is about 200 RMB. If I choose option 1, I won’t get the shoes and will lose 200 RMB.)

src: 选择2，我有鞋子，最后补偿了我2000日元，最后损失在150rmb 客服：我们已记录下来，我们会认真处理，次日回了封邮件，说我不接受中方客服调解，就这么完了。
raw:
I chose option 2; I had shoes, and in the end, they compensated me with 2000 yen. The total loss was 150 RMB. 
Customer service: We have recorded this, and we will handle it seriously. The next day, they sent an email saying that I did not accept the mediation offered by the Chinese customer service team, and that was the end of the matter.

src: 我提出：购买的页面为7c，8，9c这样具有迷惑性的选项时，中方客服帮我说起了日本常用码是不会带c这样的，类似140这样的，但是你们特么有去其他毛毛虫页面看吗？
raw: I mentioned that on the purchase page, there were confusing options like 7c, 8c, 9c. The Chinese customer service staff helped me by explaining that the Japanese standard codes don’t use the letter “c”; instead, they use numbers like 140. But have you even checked the other related pages (like the “caterpillar”-related ones)?

src: 都有美码，日码混标的情况出现。
raw: Both US and Japanese size labels are sometimes used interchangeably.

src: 再说，你8cm为什么放在7c和9c中间，明明最小的尺码，你放那里算什么意思。
raw: Besides, why have you placed the 8cm ruler between the 7cm and 9cm rulers? It’s clearly the smallest size of all; what does it mean to put it there?

src: 中方客服：我们提供中文服务，但是不知道你要运回国，所以你的运费我们是不予理赔的。
raw: Chinese customer service: We provide services in Chinese, but since we don’t know that you are shipping the item back to your home country, we will not cover the shipping costs for you.

src: 这个逻辑我又不懂了，我是日本人，我还要中文客服，生活在日本的中国也不需要中文客服，去日本游客，没有那个功夫打国际长途，那么问题来了，什么人需要打亚马逊海外购中文电话，无非像我这样日淘的。
raw: I don’t understand this logic anymore. I’m Japanese, and I still need Chinese-language customer support. Chinese people living in Japan don’t need Chinese-language customer support either. Tourists who come to Japan don’t have the time to make international long-distance calls. So the question is: Who exactly needs to make Chinese-language calls to Amazon’s overseas shopping services? It’s probably people like me who shop on Japanese online platforms.

src: 亚马逊中文客服不就是方便了我们海淘的这些人吗？
raw: Isn’t the Chinese customer service on Amazon just there to make it easier for us people who shop overseas?

src: 包装破损了，等时间来检验产品的质量。
raw: The packaging is damaged; we need to wait for some time to assess the quality of the product.

src: 外包装破损较严重，里面的包装盒似乎是新的，但是说明书好像不是新的，九月才装修，囤货中，希望到时候不会是坏的，请亚马逊解释一下为什么好几个顾客提到包装破损，你们却能安然处之，谢谢！
raw: The outer packaging is severely damaged; the inner box seems to be new, but the instruction manual does not appear to be new. The house was renovated in September, and we are stocking up on products. I hope they will not be damaged by the time they are delivered. Please explain to Amazon why several customers have mentioned the packaging damage, yet you seem to be unbothered by this issue. Thank you!

src: 东西很好，平台官僚依旧
raw: The products are good, but the platform’s bureaucracy remains the same.

src: 硬盘质量非常好，性价比绝对高，比香港买还便宜，不急着用和可以忍受物流的话绝对推荐购买。
raw: The quality of the hard drive is very good, and the cost-performance ratio is definitely excellent; it’s even cheaper than buying it in Hong Kong. If you don’t need it urgently and can tolerate the shipping time, I highly recommend purchasing it.

src: 但不得不说的是亚马逊平台之官僚依旧，与几年前我发誓绝对不用的时候没有改进，你永远查不到实际物流状况，信息永远是几个星期以后送到，永远不能投诉，就是这么官僚！
raw: But it has to be said that the bureaucracy on the Amazon platform remains the same as it was a few years ago, when I vowed never to use it again. You can never find out the actual status of the delivery; the information always indicates that the goods will be delivered in a few weeks, and you can never file a complaint. That’s just how bureaucratic it is!

src: 货收到几天了，物流信息还是10几天后你将会收到货！
raw: It’s been a few days since the goods were received, but the logistics information still states that you will receive them in another 10 or so days!

src: 喜出望外
raw: Overjoyed

src: 买之前心里真的没底，直到打开一看包装就感觉很正！
raw: I was really unsure before making the purchase, but as soon as I opened the package, I felt that everything looked very authentic and trustworthy!

src: 最后当我触碰到耳机线的时候，感觉特别柔韧，质量太好了，迫不及待插到手机上打开qq音乐。
raw: Finally, when I touched the cable of the headphones, I felt how incredibly flexible it was; the quality is really excellent. I couldn’t wait to connect them to my phone and start using QQ Music.

src: 我惊愕了，音质竟然是环绕3D立体！
raw: I was amazed; the sound quality is actually 3D surround!

src: 我在实体通讯店问过了，差不多的30左右，但绝不是品胜牌子的，是杂牌的，因此说这款品胜虽然27块，但是性价比绝对的值得拥有！
raw: I asked at a physical communications store, and the price is around 30 yuan. However, it’s definitely not a Pisen brand product; it’s a generic brand. So even though this Pisen product costs 27 yuan, the cost-performance ratio is absolutely worth it!

src: 物流太慢
raw: The logistics are too slow.

src: 显示10月16号到，结果21号才收到，差评！
raw: It was supposed to be delivered by October 16th, but I received it only on the 21st. What a poor service!

src: 快递太差，亚马逊上买东西本来就慢，没想到会这么慢！
raw: The delivery service is terrible; buying things from Amazon is already slow enough, but I didn’t expect it to be this slow!

src: 错误的配图
raw: The wrong image/illustration has been used.

src: 我以为自己能够收到图1这样的耳机，没想到却收到了图2这样的耳机，图物不一致也就算了，耳机左右声音大小不一又是什么意思？
raw: I thought I would receive headphones similar to the ones shown in Figure 1, but instead I got the ones shown in Figure 2. Apart from the mismatch in the appearance of the products, what does it mean that the volume levels of the sound on the left and right sides of the headphones are different?

src: 虽然名称都是一样的，但还是希望大家能够小心注意，另外还请亚马逊负责人及时更换正确的配图，万分感谢。
raw: Although the names are the same, I still hope everyone will be careful. Additionally, I would like to ask the person in charge at Amazon to replace the images with the correct ones as soon as possible. Thank you very much.

src: 让人无法理解的袖子
raw: Sleeves that are simply impossible to understand…

src: 说是牛皮的，也确实比较硬，但仔细看的话，局部有很多细小的裂痕，搞不清楚是否是真皮的，另外这个衣服的袖子真是让人无法理解，通常夹克的袖子要比衣摆长一些，不过通常也就1-2厘米，这件衣服足足长了5厘米，手臂自然下垂应该在手掌虎口的位置，但这件衣服的袖子都盖过手指了。
raw: It’s claimed to be made of cowhide, and indeed it’s quite hard. However, upon closer inspection, there are many tiny cracks in certain areas; it’s unclear whether this is due to the material being genuine leather or not. Additionally, the sleeves of this garment are absolutely baffling. Normally, the sleeves of a jacket are longer than the hem of the jacket itself—by about 1-2 centimeters at most. But in this case, the sleeves are 5 centimeters longer than the hem. When the arms hang down naturally, they should reach the area between the palms and the fingertips; yet, with these sleeves, they actually cover the fingers as well.

src: 是横杠的！
raw: It’s the hyphen!

src: 亚马逊图片上是斜杠的，结果给我发来是横杠的，这不是骗人吗?
raw: On the Amazon image, the symbol is a slash (/), but the one they sent me is a hyphen (-). Isn’t that just fraud?

src: 最差的网购体验
raw: The worst online shopping experience ever.

src: 9月28号下单后，系统显示已经发货，结果一直等到10月12号依然没有收到货。
raw: After placing the order on September 28th, the system indicated that the product had been shipped. However, I still haven’t received it until October 12th.

src: 查询亚马逊订单状态，卖家没有提供快递单号，查不到订单在哪儿。
raw: I’m trying to check the status of an Amazon order, but the seller hasn’t provided a tracking number, so I can’t find out where the order is.

src: 于是发邮件给卖家问是否能提供快递单号，过了两天一直没有回复。
raw: So, I sent an email to the seller asking if they could provide the tracking number for the shipment. Two days passed, and there was no response.

src: 无奈之下，打亚马逊客服，客服告诉了卖家的手机号码，我再打电话问店家，打了几次之后，电话通了，被告知快递丢件了，可以立刻再重新发我一个。
raw: Out of options, I contacted Amazon customer service, who provided me with the seller’s phone number. I then called the seller several times, and finally the call went through. I was informed that the package had been lost and that they could send me a new one immediately.

src: 虽然我特别生气，但是由于电脑急需要，所以也就没跟卖家多说，只要立刻发给我就好。
raw: Although I was really angry, due to the urgent need for the computer, I didn’t say much to the seller. I just wanted it to be sent to me as soon as possible.

src: 结果，第二天打电话问，发货了吗？
raw: As a result, the next day I called to ask if the product had been shipped yet.

src: 卖家说还没，下午才能发。
raw: The seller said it’s not available yet, and it will only be sent in the afternoon.

src: 我下午又打电话问，卖家说一定发，下午五六点之后发货，结果等我晚上七点打电话，电话就没人接了。
raw: I called again this afternoon, and the seller said they would definitely send the item, with shipping expected after 5 or 6 pm. However, when I called again at 7 pm, no one answered the phone.

src: 第三天上午我又打，问货发出去了吗？
raw: On the morning of the third day, I called again to ask if the goods had been sent out.

src: 可以告诉我订单号了么？
raw: Could you please tell me the order number?

src: 卖家说没发，告诉我要是着急的话让我从别家订货，要是可以等的话下午就发。
raw: The seller said that the item hadn’t been sent yet and told me that if I was in a hurry, I should place an order with another supplier; if I could wait, it would be sent in the afternoon.

src: 没办法，从别家下单又要等好久。
raw: There’s no other way; I’d have to place an order with another company, and then wait a long time again.

src: 就只能拜托卖家赶紧发货。
raw: So I can only ask the seller to please ship the product as soon as possible.

src: 终于在无数个电话跟踪之后，我在10月16号收到了电脑。
raw: Finally, after countless phone calls and follow-ups, I received the computer on October 16th.

src: 至于电脑的质量怎样，我不知道，因为是给别人买的，后期再追加评论吧。
raw: As for the quality of the computer, I don’t know because it was bought for someone else; I’ll add my comments later on.

src: 假货，假的特别厉害
raw: Fake products… and the fake ones are especially impressive (in a negative way).

src: 亚马逊卖假货，我也是服了。
raw: Amazon sells fake products – I really can’t believe it.

src: 客服说因为用了所以不能退货，我没用怎么知道是假货。
raw: The customer service said that since the product was already used, it couldn’t be returned. But if I didn’t use it at all, how would I have known it was a fake product?

src: 因为信任，所以伤心，毕竟是抹脸的用品，真的去实体店买吧，认可贵一点。
raw: Because of the trust, I feel disappointed; after all, it’s a product used for applying makeup to the face. It’s really better to buy it from a physical store and be willing to pay a higher price.

src: 因为是秒杀，所以没有看评论，我已经提交国家工商总局的电商平台了，我们一起维权吧。
raw: Since it was a flash sale, I didn’t read the reviews. I have already submitted a report to the State Administration for Industry and Commerce regarding the e-commerce platform involved. Let’s stand together for our rights.

src: 郁闷的体验
raw: A frustrating experience

src: 之前在别家网购的滤芯，过滤效果不错，28天结束之后再用多一两天也一样没有水垢。
raw: The filter cartridges I bought online from another store before worked well in terms of filtration performance. Even after the 28-day period had passed, using them for one or two more days didn’t result in any water scale buildup.

src: 由于一直以来在亚马逊购置的东西品质都可以，这次就想着在这边买，第一次在亚马逊买滤芯，感觉不太好，不但早早就开始有水垢，而且滤芯一直用到第28天，都会有悬浮的小黑碳粉，真不知道是继续用下去，还是直接扔了好，非常郁闷~
raw: Since the quality of the products I’ve bought from Amazon has always been satisfactory, I decided to make a purchase there this time. It was my first time buying a water filter from Amazon. However, the experience wasn’t good at all: scale started forming on the filter quite early on, and even after using it for 28 days, there were still small, black carbon particles floating in the water. I really don’t know whether I should continue using it or just throw it away… I’m very frustrated!

src: 优惠后很划算，亚马逊假优惠很伤心
raw: It’s really a good deal after the discount is applied; it’s sad though when Amazon offers fake discounts.

src: 宝宝出生一周购买，保温超强。
raw: Purchased one week after the baby was born; it provides excellent heat retention.

src: 壶的外面摸不到一丝热量，即不怕烫到人也能有效保护温度不外散。
raw: Not a single trace of heat can be felt from the outside of the pot; this means it can effectively protect the temperature from being lost, even in cases where there is no risk of scalding people.

src: 经过一个晚上空调房依然能保持很高的温度。
raw: Even after a night, the room with the air conditioner still maintains a very high temperature.

src: 亚马逊说周年活动320大优惠，后来发现大家249,289,299都有，瞬间有种被欺骗感，但是去超市对比了一下依然比同价位各种杂牌划算多了，今后外出可随车携带。
raw: Amazon claimed there were 320 great discounts for the anniversary event, but later I realized that prices like 249, 289, and 299 were available for those products too. It instantly felt like I’d been cheated. However, when I compared the prices with those of various cheaper brands at the supermarket, Amazon’s products were still much more cost-effective. From now on, I can just carry them with me when I go out.

src: 这次购买不是很满意
raw: I’m not very satisfied with this purchase.

src: 这是第二次从亚马逊上购买帮宝适尿布，曾经在宝宝2个月的时候买过一箱，选择了欧洲进口纸张的尿布，第一次购买经历还是比较满意的，宝宝整夜就用一张尿布，的确可以满足12个小时不换尿布。
raw: This is the second time I’ve purchased Pampers diapers from Amazon. I had bought a box of them when the baby was 2 months old, choosing the diapers with paper imported from Europe. I was quite satisfied with the first purchase experience; the baby used just one diaper throughout the night, and it indeed lasted for 12 hours without the need to change it.

raw: Objectively speaking, I don’t have any evidence to prove that I didn’t damage the product. However, considering my shopping history on Amazon, I believe such products shouldn’t be available among Amazon’s own-branded merchandise. When customers choose Amazon’s own-branded products, they are showing trust in the company. When the customer wins, we win; after all, the customer’s success is also the manufacturer’s success. I hope we can all work together to improve the situation. Thank you.

src: 很满意的手表
raw: A very satisfactory watch.

src: 肯定是正品，去专柜验过货，表的外观很漂亮，做工精细，用料足，加上又是进口机械机芯，所以是有一定的分量的，是那些三四百所谓的机械表不能比的，这个是货真价实的。
raw: It’s definitely a genuine product; I’ve checked it at the official store. The watch has a beautiful appearance, exquisite craftsmanship, and is made with high-quality materials. Additionally, it features an imported mechanical movement, which gives it significant weight and quality that can’t be matched by those so-called “mechanical watches” that cost only three or four hundred yuan. This one is truly authentic and of superior quality.

src: 表的走时是很准的，误差完全在可接受范围内，表的包装里有珠宝鉴定证书，表盘的12字那里是真钻石，这个自己戴很合适，作为礼品送出去也很有面子。
raw: The accuracy of the watch’s timekeeping is very high; the error is completely within an acceptable range. The watch comes with a jewelry appraisal certificate in its packaging. The 12 o’clock mark on the dial is made of genuine diamonds. It’s perfect to wear yourself, and it would also make a great gift that impresses others.

src: 宾利表确实不错。
raw: The Bentley watches are indeed quite nice.

src: 东西不错
raw: The stuff’s not bad.

raw: The product is really good; I bought it as a gift for my girlfriend. However, I had some trouble at noon when the Canadian courier service was unavailable. The logistics company simply left the package in the “Mail Storage” service without sending me a verification message regarding the pick-up, which forced me to make two trips.

src: 不过宝贝确实不错。
raw: But the baby is really nice indeed.

src: 正品哟 包装好
raw: It’s the genuine product, and it’s well-packaged.

src: 包装很完整，里面加了充气袋，没有网上评论的只有光秃秃一个产品的样子。
raw: The packaging is in good condition; an inflatable bag is included inside. The only difference from the online reviews is that the product doesn’t appear to come in its packaging with just the product itself (without any additional materials or bags).

src: 瓶子外包装上还有一层塑料膜像图片上描述的一样，快递也很快，拍下第二天就来了。
raw: There is also a layer of plastic wrap on the outer packaging of the bottle, just as described in the picture. The delivery was very fast too; it arrived the very next day after I took the photo.

src: 是正品，只是没货了，不知道什么时候再上架。
raw: It’s the genuine product; it’s just out of stock, and we don’t know when it will be available again.

src: 看起来很美好
raw: It looks wonderful.

src: 很久以前就看中这个摄像头了，但是因为除了价格外，还有一些别的原因，所以没有购买，这次因为凑包邮，价格也还可以所以就买了。
raw: I had my eye on this camera a long time ago, but I didn’t buy it due to some other reasons besides the price. This time, since the price was reasonable enough when taking advantage of the free shipping offer for buying multiple items together, I decided to go ahead and purchase it.

src: 买来之后其他的都没什么问题，就是在软件连接的时候，怎么都连不上，我家是TP的路由器，上网查了之后发现好多人都有这个问题，弄了两个多小时，各种改路由器的设置，最后我用360WIFI作为媒介给弄好的，期间给小米客服打电话，他们对这个问题也没有什么解决方法，直接就让我联系亚马逊进行售后。
raw: After making the purchase, there were no issues with anything else. However, when trying to connect the device via software, it simply wouldn’t connect. I use a TP router at home. After searching online, I found that many people were experiencing the same problem. I spent over two hours trying various methods to adjust the router’s settings. Finally, I managed to get it connected by using 360WIFI as a intermediary. During that time, I also called Xiaomi’s customer service, but they didn’t have any solutions to this issue and suggested that I contact Amazon for after-sales support.

src: 另外一点值得注意的就是我在网上看到用户的评论说，这个摄像头支持的存储卡最小是8G，存储容量更小的就不能识别，希望大家注意这点。
raw: Another point worth noting is that I saw comments from users online stating that the minimum size of the memory card supported by this camera is 8GB; any memory card with a smaller capacity will not be recognized. I hope everyone takes this into consideration.

src: 用起来感觉还可以吧，画面还可以接受，但声音音质很差，机器有一定程度的发热，一直开启的话，感觉这种程度的发热有点让人难以接受。
raw: It seems to work okay; the graphics are acceptable, but the sound quality is very poor. The device also generates a certain amount of heat, and if it’s left on all the time, the level of heat becomes quite uncomfortable.

src: 综上所述，本产品还有诸多不足，希望大家买的时候要慎重。
raw: In summary, this product still has many shortcomings, and I hope everyone will be cautious when purchasing it.

src: 轻便大容量
raw: Light and large capacity

src: 喜欢它轻便，开口大，就是两个独立的分隔袋对我来说有点多余，感觉不知道装什么好。
raw: I like its lightweight design and the large opening. However, the two separate compartments seem a bit unnecessary to me; I don’t really know what to put in them.

src: 买完发现海外购美亚上还有一只另一个牌子很类似的，才不到两百块。
raw: After making the purchase, I realized that on Amazon (for overseas purchases), there was another similar product from a different brand for just under two hundred yuan.

raw: 1. The table packaging is in a very poor state of repair (it’s severely damaged).

raw: 2. The instruction manual for the table has severe signs of wear and tear from use (i.e., it’s folded or creased due to frequent handling).

src: 3、表不走，台灯充电也无发使用，无法调整时间。
raw: 3. The clock doesn’t work; the desk lamp can’t be charged, and it can’t be used either. Additionally, it’s impossible to adjust the time.

src: 4、分别联系亚马逊客服，只能自费邮寄至美国，后补邮费。
raw: 4. Contact Amazon customer service separately; you will have to pay the shipping costs to send the item to the United States out of your own pocket, and then the additional shipping fees will be reimbursed later.

src: 5、2分的原因是客服服务还不错。
raw: The reason for the scores of 5 and 2 is that the customer service is quite good.

src: 第一次买的时候，东西有问题，所有的灯在闪烁，无法用。
raw: The first time I bought it, there was a problem with the product: all the lights were flickering and couldn’t be used.

src: 要求换货，结果货到上海都三天了，还不送过来。
raw: I requested a replacement, but even three days after the item arrived in Shanghai, it still hasn’t been delivered to me.

src: 给配送的打电话也不接。
raw: They don’t even answer the phone when you call them to arrange delivery.

src: 快递公司说，他们只有那个联系方式。
raw: The courier company said that they only have that contact information.

src: 亚马逊找不到投诉的地方。
raw: Amazon can’t find where the complaint should be filed.

src: 没有要求过，延迟送货的情况下，莫名其妙按我的要求延迟送货－这样的短信过来。
raw: No request was made; however, in the case of a delayed delivery, they inexplicably delayed the delivery according to my request – and then this kind of message was sent to me.

src: 后面又说什么中转问题。
raw: Then they talked about some transfer issues again.

src: 反正极差的购物体验，开始怀疑亚马逊的物流系统及控制系统的有效性。
raw: Anyway, it was a really poor shopping experience, which has made me start to doubt the effectiveness of Amazon’s logistics system as well as its control systems.

src: 估计今天也拿不到。
raw: I don’t think I’ll be able to get it today either.
